title: Hum Apne Bacchon Ko Kis Duniya Ke Liye Taiyaar Kar Rahe Hain
content:
Raat ke kareeb 11 baje the.

Bacche so chuke the.
Ghar mein khamoshi thi… lekin uske dimaag mein bahut shor tha.

Woh bas kuch minute ke liye mobile par reels dekh rahi thi.

Pehli reel aayi—
**“Duniya mein natural disasters badh rahe hain…”**

Agli reel—
**“Bacchon mein obesity aur lifestyle diseases badh rahi hain…”**

Phir kisi ne kaha—
**“Ye food bilkul mat khilaiye.”**

Aur agle hi video mein koi keh raha tha—
**“Ye food toh health ke liye bahut achha hai.”**

Usne mobile side mein rakh diya.

Lekin sawaal… abhi bhi dimaag mein ghoom rahe the.

mein ne apne soye hue bacche ko dekha.

Aur dheere se socha—

**“Aakhir hum apne bacchon ko kaisi duniya de rahe hain?”**

Kabhi baadh…
kabhi bhookamp…
kahin war…
kahin pollution…

Natural resources dheere-dheere kam ho rahe hain.
Nayi-nayi diseases ke baare mein roz kuch na kuch sunne ko milta hai.

Aur doosri taraf…

Humne apni life convenient banane ke chakkar mein
khana bhi convenient bana diya.

Instant food.
Packaged food.
Fast food.
Zyada sugar, zyada salt… aur bas ek minute mein ready.

Bacchon ko bhi wahi tasty lagta hai.

Aur phir hum pareshaan hote hain—

Weight kyun badh raha hai?
Baccha itna tired kyun rehta hai?
Outdoor games ki jagah screen kyun pasand hai?

Lekin sabse zyada confusion kis baat ka hai?

**Kya khilayein?**

Ek reel bolti hai—
“Doodh mat piyo.”

Doosri bolti hai—
“Doodh zaroor piyo.”

Ek bolti hai—
“Ye oil unhealthy hai.”

Doosri kehti hai—
“Ye sabse healthy oil hai.”

Ek food ko villain bana deti hai…
doosri usi food ko superfood.

Kabhi kisi product ke quality ko lekar sawaal uthte hain,
kabhi kisi ingredient ko lekar.

Aur ek parent sochta reh jaata hai—

**“Main apne bacche ko safe kaise rakhoon?”**

“Main kaise jaanu ki internet par jo information mil rahi hai, woh sach hai ya sirf views ke liye banayi gayi hai?”

Us raat us mujhe  bhi darr lag ne laga.

Lekin phir mein ne apne bacche ko dekha.

Aur use ek baat samajh aayi—

**Hum apne bacchon ke liye ek perfect duniya create nahi kar sakte.**

Hum bhookamp nahi rok sakte.
Har natural disaster nahi rok sakte.
Har disease ko khatam nahi kar sakte.
Duniya mein hone wali har problem ko control nahi kar sakte.

**Lekin hum apne bacchon ko strong bana sakte hain.**

Unhe healthy habits sikha sakte hain.

Ghar ka simple khana khane ki aadat.
Fruits aur vegetables ki importance.
Outdoor games.
Proper sleep.
Limited screen time.

Aur sabse important—

**Unhe sikhana ki har viral reel sach nahi hoti.**

Health ke mamle mein information ko verify karna zaroori hai.
Har trend follow karna zaroori nahi.

Bacchon ko sirf duniya se bachana nahi hai…

**Unhe duniya ko samajhna bhi sikhana hai.**

Taaki kal jab hum unke saath hum na bhi hon,
woh khud sahi aur galat mein difference samajh sakein.

Us raat mera  darr poori tarah khatam nahi hua.

Lekin usne decide kiya—

Main apne bacche ko ek perfect future nahi de sakti…

**Lekin main use future ka saamna karne ke liye strong zaroor bana sakti hoon.**

Shayad aaj ke parents ke liye sabse bada sawaal bhi yahi hai—

### **Hum apne bacchon ko sirf successful banane ki taiyaari kar rahe hain…

ya healthy, strong aur samajhdaar banne ki bhi?**

Kya hum unhe har cheez provide karte-karte
unki health aur childhood toh nahi chheen rahe?

Kya hum convenience ke naam par
unhe unnecessarily processed food ka aadat toh nahi laga rahe?

Kya humein har viral reel par believe karne ke bajay
reliable sources aur qualified experts se information verify nahi karni chahiye?

Aur sabse bada sawaal—

### **Aane wali duniya agar aur challenging hone wali hai,

toh hum aaj se apne bacchon ko kaise prepare karein?**

**Dar dekar?**

Ya…

**Unhe healthy, aware, emotionally strong aur resilient banakar?**

Shayad jawab humein aaj se hi dhoondhna hoga.

title: Healing Is Not Weakness
content:
hello friends yeh story meri ek friend ki hai jo usne mujhse share kari thi.

Raat ke 2 baj rahe the.

Pura ghar so raha tha, lekin Meera ki aankhon mein neend nahi thi.

Kamre mein andhera tha. Phone ki screen baar-baar roshan ho rahi thi.

Ek message tha—

**“Are you okay?”**

Meera ne message padha.

Kuch seconds tak screen ko dekhti rahi.

Phir phone side mein rakh diya.

Uske paas jawab tha.

**“No.”**

Lekin woh ye shabd kisi ko bhej nahi paayi.

Kyunki kaise samjhati ki woh theek kyun nahi hai?

Uski zindagi dekhne mein bilkul normal thi.

Woh office jaati thi.

Logon se baat karti thi.

Doston ke saath hansti thi.

Family ke saamne smile karti thi.

Social media par bhi sab kuch perfect lagta tha.

Lekin jab raat hoti…

Aur duniya ki saari awaazein chup ho jaati…

Tab uske andar ki awaaz bahut tez ho jaati.

**“Tum itni thak kyun gayi ho?”**

**“Tum khush kyun nahi ho?”**

**“Tumhare saath aakhir problem kya hai?”**

Meera ke paas koi clear answer nahi tha.

Bas ek ajeeb sa bojh tha.

Kuch purani yaadein.

Kuch tootey hue rishte.

Kuch aise alfaaz jo kisi ne kabhi gusse mein keh diye the, lekin Meera ne unhe saalon tak apne dil mein sambhal kar rakha.

Aur sabse zyada—

**khud ko har cheez ke liye blame karne ki aadat.**

---

Log aksar usse kehte—

**“Tum toh bahut strong ladki ho.”**

Aur woh muskura deti.

Unhe kya pata tha ki strong dikhne ke peeche kitni baar woh bathroom mein chupkar royi thi.

Kitni baar usne apne aansu ponch kar mirror mein khud se kaha tha—

**“Bas… ab aur nahi rona.”**

Usne seekh liya tha ki apna dard chhupana aasaan hai.

Kisi ko ye batana ki tum andar se toot rahi ho…

bahut mushkil.

Isliye woh sabki sun leti thi.

Sabko samajh leti thi.

Sabko comfort karti thi.

Lekin jab baat khud ki aati—

woh chup ho jaati.

---

Ek shaam office se ghar lautte waqt Meera metro station par bheed ke beech khadi thi.

Aas-paas hazaaron log the.

Lekin us pal use duniya mein sabse zyada akela mehsoos hua.

Uski aankhon mein aansu aa gaye.

Woh jaldi se station ke ek kone mein chali gayi.

Aur phir…

woh ro padi.

Bina kisi wajah ke nahi.

Balki **bahut saari wajahen ek saath thi.**

Us din usne pehli baar apne aansuon ko rokne ki koshish nahi ki.

Usne khud ko strong banane ki koshish nahi ki.

Bas roti rahi.

Aur phir usne khud se dheere se kaha—

**“Main kab tak sabke liye strong banti rahungi?”**

Us raat ghar jaakar usne ek chhota sa decision liya.

Usne help maangne ka faisla kiya.

Pehli baar.

Usne mujhe call kiya.

Kuch seconds tak woh kuch bol nahi paayi.

Phir uski awaaz toot gayi—

**“Mujhe nahi pata mere saath kya ho raha hai… bas main bahut thak gayi hoon.”**

Doosri taraf kuch seconds ki khamoshi thi.

or mein samjh chuki thi ki vo kis pareshani mein hai 

Phir mein ne ek simple si baat boli —

**“Tumhe abhi sab kuch samajhna zaroori nahi hai. Bas itna yaad rakho… mein tumhare saath humesha hun or hamesha rahungi . ”**

Meera ki aankhon se aansu nikal aaye.

Lekin is baar woh aansu dard ke saath-saath **relief** ke bhi the.

---

Uske baad  mein ne use bahut sari purani kuch khatti kuch mithhi batein kari 

mujhe laga ki uski  thodi healing shuru ho gae hai 

Lekin healing waisi nahi thi jaisi mein soch rahi thi kyonki 

Ek din mein sab theek nahi hota.

Kuch raaton mein anxiety phir laut aati.

Kuch yaadein phir dard deti.

Kuch din woh bina kisi reason ke udaas ho jaati.

Kabhi use lagta—

**“Main phir se wahi jagah aa gayi hoon.”**

Lekin ab ek cheez badal chuki thi.

Pehle woh apne dard se bhaagti thi.

Ab woh usse samajhne ki koshish karti thi.

Pehle woh khud ko blame karti thi.

Ab woh khud se kehti—

**“Tumne bahut kuch saha hai. Tum weak nahi ho. Tum bas thak gayi ho.”**

Usne seekha ki healing ka matlab apne past ko erase kar dena nahi hota.

Healing ka matlab hai—

apne past ko accept karna,

khud ko forgive karna,

zarurat padne par help maangna,

aur dheere-dheere apne aap ko dobara choose karna.



Kuch mahine baad Meera ne apni purani diary kholi.

Pehle page par likha tha—

**“I wish I could forget everything.”**

Usne kuch der us sentence ko dekha.

Phir diary ke aakhri page par likha—

**“I don't need to forget everything. I just need to stop letting my past decide who I become.”**

Usne diary band kar di.

Khidki ke paas jaakar baith gayi.

Bahar subah ho rahi thi.

Suraj ki halki roshni uske chehre par pad rahi thi.

Meera muskuraayi.

Zindagi perfect nahi hui thi.

Uske saare zakhm gayab nahi hue the.

Lekin ab woh apne zakhmon se sharminda nahi thi.

Usne samajh liya tha—

**Healing is not weakness.**

Kabhi-kabhi apne sabse gehre dard ko accept karna hi sabse badi himmat hoti hai.


Shayad hum sabh bhi  Meera ki tarah hain.

Shayad hum  bhi sabke saamne smile karte hain aur raat ko apne thoughts ke saath ladte hain.

Shayad humare andar bhi kuch aisa hai jiske baare mein humne kabhi kisi ko nahi bataya.

Shayad aapko khud bhi samajh nahi aata ki hum itna heavy kyun feel karti hain.

**It's okay.**

hum ko har cheez ka answer aaj hi nahi chahiye.

hum ko har waqt strong rehne ki zaroorat nahi.

hum ko apne emotions ke liye maafi maangne ki zaroorat nahi.

Kabhi rona bhi healing hai.

Kabhi rukna bhi healing hai.

Kabhi kisi se kehna—

**“Mujhe help chahiye”**

bhi strength hai.

Aur agar hum or aaj aap sirf itna kar paayi hain ki apne aap  ko khud sambhal le…

**toh woh bhi ek victory hai.**

Kal ka safar kal dekhenge.

Aaj bas saans lijiye.

Khud ko thoda waqt dijiye.

Khud se thoda pyaar kijiye.

Aur yaad rakhiye—

**hum  broken nahi hain.**

**hum  healing mein hain.**

Aur healing…

**kamzori nahi hai.**

**Ye un sabse bahadur kaam mein se ek hai jo hum apne liye kar sakti hain.**

**One day, you will look back and realize—
we didn't just survive those days…
we became stronger because we chose to heal.**

title: Kuch dosti khamoshi mein khatam ho jaati hain…
content:
Kabhi-kabhi zindagi mein kuch log aise milte hain, jinse dosti ko kabhi kisi naam ya definition ki zarurat nahi padti.

Bas ek connection hota hai…

Aisi hi ek dost thi meri.

Hum college friends the. Ye koi do-chaar din ki dosti nahi thi. Saalon purani dosti thi. Humne ek-doosre ke saath bahut kuch share kiya tha—khushiyan bhi, pareshaniyan bhi.

Jab meri life mein koi problem hoti thi, woh mere saath hoti thi… aur jab uski life mein koi mushkil aati thi, main uske saath khadi hoti thi.

Usne bhi apni taraf se dosti nibhayi thi… aur shayad isi wajah se mujhe kabhi laga hi nahi tha ki ek din hum dono ke beech itni khamoshi aa jayegi.

Pehle hum regularly baat nahi karte the, lekin occasionally call ho hi jaati thi.

Phir dheere-dheere bas birthdays par ek-doosre ko call karna reh gaya tha.

Zindagi apni-apni direction mein busy ho gayi thi…

Lekin mujhe lagta tha ki dosti wahi hai.

Baat chahe kam ho jaaye, connection toh wahi rehta hai.

Lekin is baar kuch alag tha.

Mera birthday aaya… uska call nahi aaya.

Maine socha shayad busy hogi.

Phir uska birthday aaya.

Maine message kiya.

Usne message **read** toh kar liya…

Lekin reply nahi kiya.

Bas ek seen…

Aur uske baad phir wahi khamoshi.

Pata nahi kyun, us din dil mein ek ajeeb sa sawaal uthne laga—

**“Aakhir hua kya hai?”**

Kya maine kuch galat keh diya?

Kya mujhse koi mistake ho gayi?

Kya woh mujhse kisi baat par hurt hai?

Ya phir… kya ab woh mujhse baat hi nahi karna chahti?

Maine socha, assumptions banane se achha hai ek baar directly baat kar leti hoon.

Maine call kiya.

Usne call pick nahi kiya.

Maine socha shayad genuinely busy hogi…

Lekin na call back aaya, na koi message.

Aur phir kuch din beet gaye.

Sabse ajeeb baat ye thi ki mujhe usse gussa nahi aa raha tha.

Mujhe bas **samajh nahi aa raha tha.**

Itni purani dosti…

Itni saari yaadein…

Ek-doosre ki problems mein saath…

Aur phir achanak…

**Silence.**

Kabhi-kabhi kisi ka door chale jaana utna hurt nahi karta, jitna ye na pata hona ki woh door kyun gaya.

Main baar-baar sochti hoon—

**“Kya mujhe ek baar aur try karna chahiye?”**

Shayad ek call aur…

Shayad ek message aur…

Shayad woh kisi problem mein ho…

Ya shayad…

**woh bas mujhse baat nahi karna chahti.**

Aur agar woh baat nahi karna chahti, toh kya mujhe usse bhool jaana chahiye?

Kya itni purani dosti ko bina kisi explanation ke bas wahi chhod dena chahiye?

Dil kehta hai—

**“Ek baar aur try kar… itni purani dosti hai.”**

Lekin self-respect kehti hai—

**“Jahan tumhari presence unwanted ho, wahan baar-baar khud ko mat le jao.”**

Shayad dosti ka matlab sirf saath rehna nahi hota…

Kabhi-kabhi dosti ka matlab ye bhi hota hai ki saamne wala agar khamoshi choose kar raha hai, toh hum uski khamoshi ki bhi respect karein.

Main usse bhoolna nahi chahti.

Kyuki jo waqt humne saath guzara, woh meri zindagi ka hissa hai.

Usne jo achha kiya, jo saath diya, jo yaadein di…

Main un sabko kaise mita sakti hoon?

Lekin shayad ab mujhe **uske peeche jaana bhi band karna hoga.**

Main ek aakhri baar apni taraf se baat clear karne ki koshish karungi…

Aur agar phir bhi koi jawab nahi aata…

Toh shayad is baar uski khamoshi ko hi jawab maan lungi.

Dosti khatam hui ya nahi…

Ye toh shayad kabhi pata nahi chalega.

Lekin main itna zaroor chahti hoon ki kal jab main peeche mudkar dekhoon…

Toh mujhe ye regret na ho ki

**“Kaash maine ek baar aur try kiya hota.”**

Isliye ek baar aur try karungi…

Lekin uske baad…

**khud ko rok lungi.**

Kyunki kisi ko apni zindagi mein jagah dena pyaar hai…

Lekin jab saamne wala jagah na de,

**toh khud ke liye peeche hat jaana bhi zaroori hai.**

Shayad kuch dosti sach mein khatam nahi hoti…

Bas unki **baatein khatam ho jaati hain.**

Aur kuch log zindagi se chale jaate hain…

Lekin unki yaadein hamesha wahi reh jaati hain. 
 bakki aap batao mujhe kya karna chahiye ?

title: Kabhi-kabhi ghar ki baatein ghar se zyada, dimaag mein reh jaati hain
content:
Hello Friends,

Aaj ek aisi baat share karna chahti hoon jo shayad bahut si married women feel karti hain, lekin openly bol nahi paati.

Shaadi ke baad hum aksar sochte hain ki bas husband ke saath ek nayi life start karni hai. Lekin reality mein shaadi ke saath ek poora family system bhi milta hai.

Saas, sasur, jeth, jethani, devar, devrani… har kisi ka apna nature hai, apni expectations hain, apni thinking hai. Aur hum, ek nayi bahu bankar, dheere-dheere sabko samajhne ki koshish karte rehte hain.

Kisko kya pasand hai.
Kis baat par kaun offend ho jayega.
Kis se kitna bolna hai.
Kis baat ko ignore karna hai.

Aur pata hi nahi chalta ki doosron ko samajhte-samajhte hum **khud ko kitna mentally exhaust kar rahe hain.**

Mujhe lagta hai ghar ke relationships ka sabse difficult part ye nahi hai ki koi kuch keh deta hai.

Difficult part ye hai ki **woh baat humare dimaag se nikalti hi nahi.**

Kisi ne subah kuch keh diya.

Us waqt shayad hum chup reh gaye.

Lekin shaam ko wahi baat phir yaad aati hai.

Phir hum sochte hain—maine kuch galat toh nahi kaha tha? Unhone mujhe hi kyun kaha? Mujhe us waqt jawab dena chahiye tha? Kal unke saamne kaise behave karungi?

Aur kabhi-kabhi toh saamne wala insaan khud apni baat bhool chuka hota hai, lekin hum abhi bhi usi conversation ko apne dimaag mein repeat kar rahe hote hain.

Ye bahut tiring hota hai.

Aur sabse ajeeb baat ye hai ki hum apne hi ghar mein emotionally alert rehne lagte hain.

Kisi ke footsteps se mood samajhna.
Kisi ke face se guess karna ki aaj unka mood kaisa hai.
Kuch bolne se pehle sochna ki iska kya matlab nikala jayega.

Kabhi-kabhi lagta hai jaise hum ghar mein reh nahi rahe, **ghar ke reactions manage kar rahe hain.**

Aur iska effect dheere-dheere humare andar aane lagta hai.

Hum chhoti baaton par irritate hone lagte hain.
Bina wajah upset ho jaate hain.
Akele mein wahi baatein sochte rehte hain.
Kabhi husband se bhi unnecessarily frustration nikal jaati hai.
Aur kabhi bachchon ke saamne bhi hum mentally present nahi reh paate.

Kyuki body ghar mein hoti hai, lekin mind abhi bhi kisi purani conversation mein atka hota hai.

Maine ye bhi realise kiya hai ki har baat ka solution nikalna zaroori nahi hota.

Kuch log aapko kabhi samajh nahi paayenge.

Kuch log aapke efforts ko kabhi notice nahi karenge.

Kuch log aapke baare mein apni ek opinion bana lenge, chahe aap kitna bhi achha kar lo.

Pehle shayad hum har cheez explain karna chahte the. Apni side clear karna chahte the. Sabko khush rakhna chahte the.

Lekin ab lagta hai ki **har relationship ko perfect banana humari responsibility nahi hai.**

Family ko respect karna alag baat hai.

Aur apni mental peace ko sacrifice karte rehna alag.

Hum bahuon se aksar kaha jaata hai ki adjust karo, samjho, ignore karo, ghar basao.

Lekin kabhi-kabhi mujhe lagta hai ki ek baat humein khud se bhi kehni chahiye—

**“Main sabke saath achha rehne ki koshish karungi, lekin har kisi ki baat ko apne dil par nahi loongi.”**

Mujhe lagta hai ye bhi ek tarah ki maturity hai.

Har baat ka jawab dena zaroori nahi.

Har misunderstanding clear karna zaroori nahi.

Har kisi ki approval lena zaroori nahi.

Aur sabse important—**har baar khud ko galat samajhna bhi zaroori nahi.**

Agar aapne kisi ke saath bura nahi kiya, apni taraf se relationship nibhane ki honestly koshish ki hai, toh kabhi-kabhi doosre ki dissatisfaction ko bhi accept karna padega.

Sabko khush rakhna possible nahi hai.

Aur shayad shaadi ke itne saalon baad sabse important lesson yehi hai—

**Ghar sambhalte-sambhalte khud ko mat bhool jaana.**

Aapki feelings bhi important hain.

Aapka peace bhi important hai.

Aapko bhi kabhi-kabhi ghar ke kaam, responsibilities aur relationships se thoda bahar nikal kar sirf apne baare mein sochne ka haq hai.

Kyunki hum women bahut kuch sambhal leti hain.

Bas ek cheez sambhalte-sambhalte aksar reh jaati hai—

**khud ko.**

Aur shayad ab humein woh bhi sambhalna seekhna hai.

title: कुछ रिश्ते किताबों से नहीं, दिल से पढ़ाए जाते हैं
content:
आज Teachers’ Day है…

सुबह से बच्चों के मैसेज, शुभकामनाएँ और प्यार मिल रहा था।
लेकिन आज मन बार-बार पिछले **15 सालों** में चला जा रहा था…

करीब 15 साल पहले मैंने बच्चों को ट्यूशन पढ़ाना सिर्फ **टाइमपास** के लिए शुरू किया था।
तब कहाँ पता था कि यही छोटा-सा काम एक दिन मेरी ज़िंदगी का इतना बड़ा हिस्सा बन जाएगा।

इन 15 सालों में मेरी ज़िंदगी में बहुत उतार-चढ़ाव आए।
कभी मुश्किलें थीं, कभी परेशानियाँ… कभी लगा कि सब छोड़ दूँ।

लेकिन एक चीज़ मैंने कभी नहीं छोड़ी—
**बच्चों को पढ़ाना।**

क्योंकि हर दिन जब बच्चे मेरे सामने बैठते थे,
तो लगता था कि मेरी ज़िंदगी सिर्फ मेरे लिए नहीं है।
मैं किसी के भविष्य को थोड़ा-सा बेहतर बनाने में अपना योगदान दे रही हूँ।

आज कुछ पुराने बच्चे अचानक मुझसे मिलने आए।

हाथों में **कार्ड, केक, गिफ्ट और ढेर सारी यादें** थीं।
उन्होंने मुझे Thank You कहा, पुराने किस्से याद किए…

लेकिन सच कहूँ तो,
उनके दिए हुए गिफ्ट से कहीं ज्यादा खास था—

**उनका मुझे याद रखना।
इतने सालों बाद मेरे पास आना।
मेरे गले लगना। ❤️**

उस एक पल में लगा जैसे पिछले 15 सालों की सारी मेहनत का हिसाब मिल गया हो।

जब उन्होंने बताया कि कोई अच्छे कॉलेज में पहुँच गया है,
कोई अपने करियर में आगे बढ़ रहा है…

तो दिल इतनी खुशी से भर गया कि शब्द ही नहीं मिले।

मैं बस उन्हें देखती रही और मन ही मन सोचती रही—

**“शायद मैंने सच में कुछ अच्छा किया है…”**

क्योंकि रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में कई बार लगता है कि बस वही घर, वही जिम्मेदारियाँ, वही दिन…
और ज़िंदगी यूँ ही गुजरती जा रही है।

लेकिन आज अपने पुराने बच्चों को देखकर एहसास हुआ—

**ज़िंदगी सिर्फ वो नहीं है जो हमने अपने लिए बनाया,
ज़िंदगी वो भी है जो हमने दूसरों की ज़िंदगी में छोड़ा है।**

मेरे लिए Teachers’ Day का सबसे बड़ा तोहफा कोई कार्ड, केक या गिफ्ट नहीं है।

मेरा सबसे बड़ा सम्मान है कि
**मेरे पढ़ाए हुए बच्चे आज भी मुझे याद करते हैं।
मेरे पास लौटकर आते हैं।
और मुझे देखकर कहते हैं—
“Ma’am, आपने हमारे लिए बहुत कुछ किया है।”**

शायद इसी को कहते हैं…
**एक शिक्षक की असली कमाई। ❤️**

आज मुझे पहली बार सच में लगा कि
मैं सिर्फ बच्चों को पढ़ा नहीं रही थी…

**मैं उनकी ज़िंदगी की कहानी में एक छोटा-सा खूबसूरत अध्याय लिख रही थी।**

और शायद यही वजह है कि
15 साल बाद भी मेरा दिल कहता है—

**“मैंने टाइमपास के लिए पढ़ाना शुरू किया था,
लेकिन बच्चों ने मेरी ज़िंदगी को एक मतलब दे दिया।”

**Happy Teachers’ Day to me…
और मेरे उन सभी बच्चों को, जिन्होंने मुझे सिर्फ Teacher नहीं,
अपनी ज़िंदगी का एक हिस्सा माना।

title: Main Divorcee Nahi Hoon… Par Kabhi-Kabhi Divorce Chaha Hai
content:
Main ek divorcee nahi hoon.

Lekin sach kahun, **mujhe divorce chahiye tha.**

Bahut baar aisa laga ki bas… ab aur nahi. Ab is rishte mein rehna mere liye possible nahi hai. Bahut kuch saha, bahut kuch samjha, bahut baar khud ko samjhaya ki shayad kal sab better ho jayega.

Meri shaadi ke shuru se hi sasural mein bahut si cheezein mere liye difficult rahi hain. Logon ka behaviour, baatein, expectations aur woh feeling ki main chahe jitna bhi kar loon, kabhi genuinely apni nahi ho paungi.

Aur ajeeb baat ye hai ki **aaj bhi bahut kuch badla nahi hai.**

Bas main badal gayi hoon.

Ab main emotionally sabse kaafi detach ho chuki hoon. Pehle jo baatein mujhe tod deti thi, aaj unmein se bahut si baatein mujhe affect bhi nahi karti.

Lekin iska matlab ye nahi ki sab theek hai.

Kabhi-kabhi dil mein itni khatas hoti hai ki mann karta hai sab chhodkar chali jaun. Kabhi bahut rona aata hai. Kabhi sochti hoon—*main kahan fas gayi?*

Aur phir agle hi din wahi routine.

Wahi ghar. Wahi responsibilities. Wahi bachche. Wahi life.

Shayad marriage ka sabse complicated part yahi hai.

**Kisi rishte se emotionally door ho jaana aur us rishte se practically bahar nikal jaana—dono bilkul alag cheezein hain.**

Agar main aaj ghar chhod doon, toh jaungi kahan?

Bachchon ka kya hoga?

Unki responsibility kaise sambhalungi?

Financially kaise manage karungi?

Kya main itna bada decision lene ke baad apni aur bachchon ki zindagi ko stable rakh paungi?

In sawaalon ke mere paas aaj bhi saare answers nahi hain.

Aur shayad isi wajah se, har baar main ruk gayi.

Kabhi-kabhi mujhe lagta hai ki ye **comfort zone** hai. Lekin phir main sochti hoon—comfort zone hamesha comfortable hota bhi hai kya?

Kabhi-kabhi hum kisi jagah isliye nahi rukte kyunki hum khush hain.

Hum isliye rukte hain kyunki **known pain, unknown future se kam scary lagta hai.**

Ek taraf dil hai jo kehta hai, *“bas, ab bahut ho gaya.”*

Dusri taraf practical life hai jo poochti hai, *“theek hai, lekin uske baad?”*

Aur in dono ke beech ek aurat kai saal khadi reh jaati hai.

Na poori tarah rishte mein.

Na poori tarah us rishte se bahar.

Shayad isi liye divorce sirf do logon ke beech ka legal decision nahi hota. Especially jab bachche, finances, family, social expectations aur emotional history saath judi ho.

Kabhi-kabhi **relationship khatam ho chuka hota hai, lekin life usse khatam karne ki permission nahi deti.**

Main ye nahi keh rahi ki har unhappy marriage ka solution divorce hai.

Aur na hi ye keh rahi hoon ki har aurat ko sirf “strong” bankar ghar chhod dena chahiye.

Main bas ye samajhne ki koshish kar rahi hoon ki **“enough is enough” decide karna itna easy kyun nahi hota.**

Kya sirf unhappy hona kisi rishte se nikalne ke liye enough hai?

Kya bachchon ki wajah se rukna sacrifice hai, responsibility hai, ya kabhi-kabhi fear?

Kya emotional detachment bhi ek tarah ka survival mechanism hai?

Aur sabse bada sawaal—

**Kya kisi rishte se bahar nikalne ke liye usse sirf bura hona zaroori hai, ya kabhi-kabhi sirf itna kaafi hona chahiye ki aap usmein khush nahi hain?**

Shayad mere paas in sawaalon ke answers nahi hain.

Lekin mujhe lagta hai in par baat honi chahiye.

Without judging the woman who leaves.

And without judging the woman who stays.

Because sometimes, **staying is not weakness… and leaving is not failure.**

Kabhi-kabhi dono ke peeche ek poori kahani hoti hai, jo bahar se dikhai hi nahi deti.

title: kya aap k Liye Sirf Ek Chhutti hai ya, Kanha Ji Ka Janamdin
content:
Kal Janmashtami hai… yaani hum sabke pyare Kanha Ji ka birthday! 🎂💙

Mere liye bachpan se Janmashtami ka matlab bas itna hi tha—chhutti, vrat aur mandir ke darshan।
Ghar mein pooja hoti thi, hum mandir jaate the aur phir lagta tha ki bas, Janmashtami khatam।

Lekin ek baa mein ek aisi friend k ghar gae  jo Mathura se belong karti thi… aur uske nazariye ne mere liye Janmashtami manane ka matlab hi badal diya।

Woh Kanha Ji ko Janmashtami par Laddu Gopal Ji ke roop mein poojti thi।

Ek Janmashtami par main uske ghar gayi। Sach kahun toh mujhe laga tha ki ek normal si holiday hogi… lekin uske ghar pahunchte hi mujhe laga jaise main kisi birthday celebration mein aa gayi hoon! 😍

Uske ghar mein sabhi bahut excited the।

Uski mummy subah se tarah-tarah ki mithaiyan bana rahi thi, jinhe woh “paag” kehti thi—makhane ka paag, nariyal ka paag, mingiyon ka paag aur na jaane kitne tarah ke paag!

Udhar meri friend aur uska bhai Laddu Gopal Ji ke liye jhoola saja rahe the। Mandir ko lights, phoolon aur gubbaron se decorate kiya ja raha tha। 🎈🌸✨

Uncle ji bhi bahar se fruits aur pooja ka samaan lekar aaye।

Ghar ka har kona ek hi cheez keh raha tha—

“Aaj Kanha Ji ka birthday hai!” 💙

Main un sabko dekhkar hairaan thi।

Mere liye toh Janmashtami ek vrat aur mandir jaane ka din tha, lekin unke liye woh ghar ke sabse chhote aur sabse pyare member ka birthday tha।

Phir raat hui…

Main apne ghar wapas aa gayi। Mandir ke darshan kiye, khana khaya aur sone ke liye let gayi।

Lekin na jaane kyun… neend hi nahi aa rahi thi।

Main baar-baar soch rahi thi—

“Pata nahi meri friend ke ghar abhi kya ho raha hoga?”

“Sab log kitne excited honge…”

“Raat ke 12 bajne wale honge… aur phir Laddu Gopal Ji ka janam hoga!” ❤️

Tabhi mere mann mein ek ajeeb sa sawaal aaya—

“Hum apne ghar mein kisi apne ka birthday itni khushi se manate hain… toh Kanha Ji ko apna maan kar unka birthday kyun nahi mana sakte?”

Aur bas…

Us raat meri soch badal gayi।

Maine khud se ek promise kiya—

“Agli Janmashtami se main bhi Kanha Ji ka birthday sirf ek festival ki tarah nahi, balki apne ghar ke ek pyare member ke birthday ki tarah manaungi।” 💙🦚

Jhoola sajaungi, ghar decorate karungi, paag banaungi… aur raat ke 12 baje bilkul waise hi celebrate karungi jaise mere ghar mein kisi apne ka birthday hota hai। 🎂✨

Shayad isi ko kehte hain bhakti ko mehsoos karna।

Kyunki kabhi-kabhi Bhagwan humein kisi mandir mein nahi…
kisi apne ke ghar ki khushi mein milte hain। ❤️

Ab aap bataiye…

Aapke liye Janmashtami sirf ek holiday hai, ya phir Laddu Gopal Ji ka Janamdivas?

title: Shaadi… humne ise choose karna kab seekha?
content:
Kabhi kabhi sochti hoon…
**shaadi ke decision ka safar bhi hamari society ke badalne ki kahani hai.**

Ek waqt tha jab shaadi ka decision ladka aur ladki nahi, **parivaar lete the.**

Ladka-ladki ne shayad ek dusre ko dekha bhi nahi tha.
Kuch sawal pooche gaye, kundli dekhi gayi, families mili… aur shaadi ho gayi.

Uske baad zindagi ka ek simple sa rule tha —

**“Ab shaadi ho gayi hai, toh ek dusre ko samajhna hai, adjust karna hai aur nibhana hai.”**

Aur log nibhate bhi the.

Khush bhi rehte the, compromise bhi karte the, ladte bhi the, roothte bhi the…
Lekin aksar unke paas **“kya main is relationship mein rehna chahti hoon?”** poochne ka option hi nahi hota tha.

Phir dheere-dheere waqt badla.

Ladka-ladki shaadi se pehle milne lage.
Baat karne lage.
Apni pasand-napasand batane lage.

Family ab bhi decision ka important hissa thi,
lekin pehli baar **ladka aur ladki ki awaaz bhi sunai dene lagi.**

Phir hum ek aur stage par aaye.

Ab sirf milna aur baat karna kaafi nahi tha.

Log ek dusre ko *jaan-na* chahne lage.

Nature kaisa hai?
Career ko lekar kya soch hai?
Paise ko lekar kya expectations hain?
Family responsibilities ko kaise dekhte ho?
Bachchon ko lekar kya views hain?
Lifestyle kaisa chahiye?
Aur sabse important —

**“Kya hum dono ek saath khush reh sakte hain?”**

Shaadi ab sirf **“achha ladka” ya “achhi ladki”** milne ka naam nahi rahi.

Ye do individuals ki compatibility ka decision banne lagi.

Aur phir ek aur thought aaya —

**“Shaadi ka decision lene se pehle ek saath rehkar kyun na dekhein?”**

Live-in relationships isi changing mindset ka ek extension hain.

Pehle ek dusre ko sirf conversations mein nahi,
**daily life mein dekhna.**

Kaun gusse mein kaisa behave karta hai…
Kaun responsibilities se bhaagta hai…
Kaun doosre ki boundaries samajhta hai…
Kaun sirf achhe waqt ka partner hai aur kaun difficult days mein bhi saath khada rehta hai.

Aur phir decide karna —

**“Kya main is insaan ke saath poori zindagi bitana chahti hoon?”**

Soch badal gayi hai.

Pehle tha —
**“Shaadi kar lo, phir ek dusre ko samajh lena.”**

Phir hua —
**“Pehle ek dusre ko samjho, phir shaadi karo.”**

Aur aaj kuch log kehte hain —
**“Pehle saath rehkar dekhte hain, phir decide karenge ki shaadi karni bhi hai ya nahi.”**

Lekin is poore safar mein ek bahut gehra sawaal chhupa hua hai…

### **Kya kisi insaan ko shaadi se pehle poori tarah jaana kabhi possible hai?**

Hum khud ko hi kitna jaante hain?

Jo insaan aaj hai, kya woh 10 saal baad bhi wahi rahega?

Humari priorities badalti hain.
Humare dreams badalte hain.
Humari responsibilities badhti hain.
Kabhi career important ho jata hai, kabhi family.
Kabhi hum emotionally strong hote hain, kabhi bilkul toot jaate hain.

Toh phir kisi doosre insaan ko *“completely know”* karke shaadi karne ka idea shayad thoda unrealistic hai.

**Shaadi se pehle hum ek insaan ko jaan sakte hain…
lekin shaadi ke baad hi hum us insaan ke bahut saare roop dekhte hain.**

Woh jab fail hota hai…
jab pareshan hota hai…
jab paison ki tension hoti hai…
jab family mein problem hoti hai…
jab hum dono ki expectations takraati hain…
jab pyaar ke saath responsibilities bhi aa jaati hain…

Tab shayad hum ek dusre ko *actually* jaan-na shuru karte hain.

Isliye shayad sawaal sirf ye nahi hona chahiye —

**“Kya main is insaan ko achhe se jaanti hoon?”**

Sawaal ye bhi hona chahiye —

**“Kya main is insaan ke badalte hue versions ke saath bhi grow kar sakti hoon?”**

Aur…

**“Kya ye insaan mere badalte hue versions ko bhi accept kar paayega?”**

Kyuki shaadi shayad kisi perfect insaan ko choose karna nahi hai.

**Shaadi ek aise insaan ko choose karna hai jiske saath hum imperfect hote hue bhi apni zindagi grow kar sakein.**

Pehle shaadi ek **zimmedari** thi.
Phir ek **decision** bani.
Aur aaj kai logon ke liye ek **choice** hai.

Lekin choice ke saath ek aur cheez aati hai —

**responsibility.**

Apni choice ki.
Apni happiness ki.
Apne relationship ki.

Aur shayad isi liye aaj shaadi ka decision pehle se zyada complicated bhi hai… aur zyada personal bhi.

**Aap kya sochte hain?**

Kya shaadi se pehle ek dusre ko jitna zyada jaanenge, utni hi successful marriage hogi?

Ya phir koi bhi relationship tabhi truly samajh aata hai jab hum usse **real life ke ups and downs mein jeete hain?**

**Kya “knowing someone before marriage” is enough?
Ya “willingness to understand each other after marriage” zyada important hai?**

Let's talk.
**Without judgement. ❤️**

title: Ghar wahi hai jahan dil lagta hai.
content:
hello freinds,
Kabhi-kabhi mujhe lagta hai ki ghar ek jagah nahi hota.

Ghar ek awaaz hoti hai…
rasoi se aati hui maa ki pukaar,
subah mandir ki ghanti,
Papa ka अख़बार पलटने का शोर,
भाई-बहन की छोटी-सी लड़ाई,
और दादी की वही पुरानी कहानी, जिसे हम हर साल सुनते थे, फिर भी हर बार नई लगती थी।

बचपन में मुझे लगता tha ki ghar bas woh jagah hai jahan hum rehte hain. Lekin jaise-jaise badi hui, samajh aaya ki ghar toh un logon se banta hai, jinke saath hum apni zindagi ke chhote-chhote pal baantte hain.

Mujhe aaj bhi Rakhi ka woh din yaad hai.

Subah se ghar mein ek alag hi raunak hoti thi. Maa kitchen mein khana bana rahi hoti thi  aur main baar-baar ghadi dekhti thi ki bhai kab aayega. Rakhi baandhne ke baad milne wala gift mere liye zaroor important tha, lekin usse zyada important tha woh ek din, jab hum dono bina lade saath baithte the.

Diwali bhi kuch aisi hi thi.

Ghar ki safai se zyada mujhe woh shaam yaad hai jab hum sab milkar diye jalate the. Dadi har baar kehti thi, "Diya chhota ho ya bada, roshni apna kaam karti hai."

Tab unki baat bas ek kahawat lagti thi.

Aaj samajh aati hai.

Zindagi mein kuch log bhi diye jaise hote hain. Woh hamesha hamare saath nahi rehte, lekin unki di hui roshni bahut door tak saath chalti hai.

Dadi ki kahaniyan bhi mere liye kisi diye se kam nahi thi.

Woh aksar raat ko humein apne bachpan ke kisse sunaya karti thi. Hum बीच में हँसते, सवाल करते, kabhi unki baat kaat dete. Aur woh har baar kehti, "Tum log bade ho jaoge na, toh inhi baaton ko yaad karoge."

Tab hum hans dete the.

Aaj jab kabhi ghar se door hoti hoon, toh unki wahi baatein achanak yaad aa jaati hain.

Tab samajh aata hai ki unhone sirf kahaniyan nahi sunayi thi…
woh humare andar ek ghar bana rahi thi.

Aaj festivals pe ghar pehle jaisa nahi lagta.

Kuch log doosre shehron mein hain. Kuch apni zindagi mein busy hain. Kabhi video call par Rakhi bandhti hai, kabhi Diwali ki mithai screen ke us paar se dikhai jaati hai.

Aur kabhi-kabhi festival ke din ghar mein sab kuch hota hai—diye, mithai, lights, decorations…

Bas kisi ek apne ki kami hoti hai.

Tab pata chalta hai ki ghar ki khamoshi bhi bahut kuch keh sakti hai.

Lekin shayad ghar ki khoobsurti isi mein hai.

Hum chahe kitni bhi door chale jaayein, kitne bhi naye shehar dekh lein, kitne bhi naye logon se mil lein… kuch jagah aur kuch rishte humare andar hamesha waise hi rehte hain.

Mere liye ghar ek address nahi hai.

Ghar woh hai jahan meri bachpan ki hansi abhi bhi kahin na kahin goonjti hai.

Woh hai jahan Rakhi ka ek dhaaga sirf kalai par nahi, dil par bandhta hai.

Woh hai jahan Diwali ka diya sirf aangan nahi, yaadon ko roshan karta hai.

Woh hai jahan Dadi ki kahaniyan waqt ke saath purani nahi hoti.

Aur woh hai jahan apne log paas ho ya door…

dil ko unki taraf lautne ke liye kisi raste ki zaroorat nahi padti.

Shayad isi liye kehte hain—

Ghar wahi hai jahan dil lagta hai.

Aur mera dil…

aaj bhi wahi laga hua hai.

title: Kya Financial Independence Mere Liye Sirf Paise Kamana Hai?
content:
Mere saath ek ajeeb si problem hai… **self-respect ki.**

Main apni chhoti-chhoti zarooratein poori kiye bina reh sakti hoon, lekin kisi par apna burden daalna mujhe bahut mushkil lagta hai.

Pehle jab Papa mere kharche uthate the, tab bhi andar se ek feeling hoti thi ki *“kya mujhe ye khud nahi karna chahiye?”*

Aaj mere pati mere liye bahut si cheezein karte hain, meri zarooratein poori karte hain. Main jaanti hoon ki woh ise burden nahi samajhte. Mere liye bhi unka saath koi ehsaan nahi hai.

Phir bhi… mere andar kahin ek awaaz hai jo kehti hai—

**“Jo chahiye, woh apni kamai se kharid paun.”**

Baat badi cheezon ki nahi hai.

Kabhi koi chhoti si cheez pasand aa gayi, le sakti hoon… phir bhi nahi leti.

Kabhi kuch apne liye karne ka mann hua, toh soch leti hoon—
*“Rehne do… zaroori toh nahi hai.”*

Aur kabhi zaroori hone ke bawajood bhi bas isliye chhod deti hoon ki **kahin kisi par extra kharcha na ban jaaye.**

Shayad yahi wajah hai ki mere liye financial independence ka matlab sirf **khud paise kamana** nahi hai.

Mere liye iska matlab hai—

**Apni chhoti-chhoti khushiyon ke liye kisi se permission maangne ki zaroorat mehsoos na ho.**

Apni zarooraton ko “extra” samajhkar baar-baar postpone na karna pade.

Aur sabse important…

**Apne liye kuch kharch karte waqt guilt na ho.**

Main ye nahi keh rahi ki kisi ka saath lena galat hai.

Nahi.

Zindagi mein hum sab kabhi na kabhi kisi ke sahare hote hain. Parents bachpan mein sambhalte hain, partner zindagi ke kisi phase mein sambhal sakta hai. Ismein koi burai nahi.

Lekin shayad meri self-respect mujhe ye keh rahi hai ki—

**“Main bhi itni capable banna chahti hoon ki apni chhoti-chhoti zarooraton ka bojh khud utha sakun.”**

Shayad isi liye mere liye financial independence ek choice se zyada **ek emotional need** ban gayi hai.

Aur shayad har woman ke liye financial independence ka matlab alag hota hai.

Kisi ke liye security.

Kisi ke liye freedom.

Kisi ke liye confidence.

Aur kisi ke liye…
**apne liye kuch maangne ya kharch karne par guilt-free hone ki azaadi.**

**Aapke liye financial independence ka kya matlab hai?**

title: Ek Aisi Job Jiska Koi Manual Nahi
content:
Jab aap parent bante ho na,
toh koi aapko koi manual nahi deta.

Koi nahi batata ki—

Baby raat ko baar-baar roye toh kya karna hai.

Toddler supermarket mein tantrum kare toh kaise handle karna hai.

Ya phir jab aap khud bahut tired ho aur samajh nahi aa raha ho ki,
**"Main sahi kar bhi rahi hoon ya nahi?"**

Phir bhi...

Har parent kisi na kisi tarah shuru karta hai.

Ek chhote se baby ko arms mein lekar,
mind mein hazaar questions lekar,
aur dil mein ek aisa love lekar, jo usne pehle kabhi feel nahi kiya hota.

---

Raat ke 3:17 baj rahe hain.

Aap bahut tired ho.

Baby bhi ro raha hai.

Laundry abhi bhi pending padi hai.

Kitchen mein dishes bhi clean karni hain.

Aur subah ke breakfast ka bhi kuch decide nahi hua hai.

Aap clock ki taraf dekhte ho
aur samajh nahi aata ki ab kya karein.

Us moment mein aapka mann karta hai ki koi bas aapko bata de—

**"Ab kya karna hai?"**

Tabhi baby rona band kar deta hai
aur apni chhoti si ungli se aapki finger pakad leta hai.

Phir aap uski pyari si smile dekhte ho...

Aur kuch pal ke liye aapki saari pareshani khatam ho jaati hai.

Aap tired the.

Bahut zyada tired the.

Lekin us moment mein aapko ek baat samajh aati hai—

**Shayad parenting ka matlab har cheez ka answer jaana nahi hai.**

Shayad parenting ka matlab hai...

**bas har baar present rehna.**

Jab aap tired ho, tab bhi.

Jab aap confused ho, tab bhi.

Jab aapko lage ki aap perfect parent nahi ho, tab bhi.

---

Aur phir...

Agli subah naye challenges ke saath shuru hoti hai.

Breakfast jal jaata hai.

Toddler milk gira deta hai.

Aur jaise hi aap khana khane baithte ho,
baby phir rone lagta hai.

Aur tabhi...

Aap muskura dete ho.

Isliye nahi ki sab kuch perfect ho gaya.

Balki isliye kyunki aapne seekh liya hai ki parenting ke iss beautiful chaos mein...

**kabhi-kabhi hasna bhi zaroori hai.**

Kyuki parenting perfect hone ka naam nahi hai.

Ye seekhne ka naam hai.

Har din thoda seekhna.

Kabhi galti karna.

Kabhi hasna.

Kabhi thak jaana.

Aur phir bhi...

**agle din dobara try karna.**

Because parenting may not come with a manual,
**but love has always been the best guide.** ❤️

title: Divorce ya life time adjustment
content:
Hello Friends,

Aaj main zindagi ke ek aise mod par khadi hoon, jahan mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki main kya karun aur kaunsa decision loon.

Meri shaadi ko abhi sirf  1 month  hua hai, lekin is ek mahine mein maine bahut kuch feel kiya hai. Main apne in-laws ke saath adjust karne ki poori koshish kar rahi thi, lekin baat-baat par taane sunna aur khud ko akela mehsoos karna mere liye bahut difficult ho raha tha.

Sabse zyada dukh tab hota hai jab jis insaan ke saath humne poori zindagi bitane ka sapna dekha ho, wahi humein samajhne aur support karne ke bajaye doosron ka saath de raha tha . Mere husband ka attitude aur behaviour mujhe bahut hurt karta tha. Kai baar aisa lagta hai ki shayad woh meri feelings ko samajh hi nahi rahe.

Jab maine apni maa ko bataya ki main wahan mentally bahut disturbed feel kar rahi hoon aur mujhse ab wahan rehna mushkil ho raha hai, to meri maa ne mujhe ghar bula liya. Ab main apne parents ke saath hoon aur dono families ke beech baat ho rahi hai.

Lekin mere mind mein ek hi question baar-baar aa raha hai—**kya sirf time ke bharose kisi relationship ko chalaya ja sakta hai? Kya time ke saath sab kuch automatically theek ho jata hai, ya phir dono logon ko milkar relationship ko better banane ki koshish karni padti hai?**

Ghar wale kehte hain ki mujhe is relationship ko thoda aur time dena chahiye. Shayad woh sahi keh rahe hain… lekin mera bhi maanna hai ki koi bhi relationship tabhi beautiful ban sakta hai jab usmein **love, respect, understanding aur support dono taraf se ho.**

Main koi bhi decision jaldi ya gusse mein nahi lena chahti. Main bas itna chahti hoon ki mujhe apni life ke liye sahi decision lene ka time aur clarity mile.

Shayad zindagi kabhi-kabhi humein difficult situations mein isliye laakar khada karti hai, taaki hum apni value, apni happiness aur apni peace ko samajh saken.

**Har relationship ek chance deserve karta hai, lekin kisi bhi relationship mein apni khushi, self-respect aur mental peace ko khona bhi theek nahi hai.**

Mujhe umeed hai ki mujhe jaldi hi apne life ka sahi raasta mil jayega. Kyunki situations chahe kitni bhi difficult kyun na ho, **ek better tomorrow ki hope hamesha hoti hai.** ❤️

Aap sab mujhe honestly batayein… aisi situation mein kya relationship ko ek aur chance dena chahiye, ya phir apni peace aur happiness ko priority deni chahiye?

title: Kya Hamari Easy Life, Hamari Mental Health Ko Difficult Bana Rahi Hai?
content:
Aaj ki life pehle se bahut easy aur convenient ho gayi hai.

Khana banana nahi hai? Bas app kholo aur kuch hi minutes mein food order.

Kahin jaana nahi hai? Online shopping kar lo.

Kisi se baat karni hai? Message ya video call kar lo.

Bore ho rahe ho? Phone uthao, Instagram kholo, YouTube dekho ya koi series laga lo.

Aur sabse interesting baat — **ye sab 24 hours available hai.**

Humein wait karne ki zarurat nahi.
Humein effort karne ki zarurat nahi.
Humein apne comfort zone se bahar nikalne ki zarurat nahi.

Lekin kabhi-kabhi sochne wali baat ye hai ki...

**Kya ye convenience hamari mental health ko quietly affect kar rahi hai?**

### 📱 Screen time sirf aankhon ko nahi, dimaag ko bhi thakata hai

Hum subah uthte hi phone check karte hain aur raat ko sone se pehle bhi phone haath mein hota hai.

Kaam ke liye screen, entertainment ke liye screen, socialising ke liye screen...

Dheere-dheere humara mind continuously stimulated rehne ka aadhi ho jata hai.

Hum physically rest kar rahe hote hain, lekin mentally humara dimaag rest nahi kar raha hota.

### 🍔 Har cheez easily available hai...

Pehle kabhi bahar ka khana khana hota tha to plan banana padta tha.

Aaj bas ek click.

Aur jab options itne saare hon, to healthy choice karna aur bhi difficult ho jata hai.

Kabhi-kabhi hum bhookh ki wajah se nahi, **convenience aur craving ki wajah se order kar rahe hote hain.**

### ⏰ Humein har waqt available rehne ki aadat ho gayi hai

Notifications, messages, calls, social media...

Humare paas "nothing to do" ka time hi nahi bacha.

Aur shayad isi wajah se **khud ke saath quietly baithna bhi uncomfortable lagne laga hai.**

Hum silence se bachne ke liye phone utha lete hain.

### 💭 Social media ne comparison bhi badha diya hai

Dusron ki life ka best part hum roz dekh rahe hain.

Kisi ka vacation, kisi ka perfect home, kisi ka career, kisi ki fitness, kisi ka happy family moment...

Aur bina realise kiye hum apni real life ko kisi aur ki highlight reel se compare karne lagte hain.

Phir lagta hai—

*"Sabki life itni achhi chal rahi hai, meri hi kyun nahi?"*

Yahi comparison dheere-dheere anxiety, dissatisfaction aur low self-worth ko badha sakta hai.

### ❤️ Shayad humein "easy life" nahi, "balanced life" chahiye

Convenience buri cheez nahi hai.

Food delivery achhi hai.
Online shopping achhi hai.
Technology zaroori hai.
Social media bhi useful ho sakta hai.

**Problem convenience nahi hai. Problem tab hoti hai jab convenience hamari choice ko control karne lage.**

Isliye shayad humein apni life mein kuch chhoti-chhoti cheezein consciously wapas laani chahiye:

🌸 Thoda kam screen time
🌸 Ghar ka simple khana
🌸 Roz thodi walk ya physical activity
🌸 Phone ke bina kuch quiet time
🌸 Social media se occasional break
🌸 Apne hobbies ke liye time
🌸 Proper sleep
🌸 Aur sabse important — **khud ke saath rehne ki aadat**

Life ko difficult banana zaroori nahi hai.

Bas har baar **sabse easy option choose karna bhi zaroori nahi hai.**

Kabhi-kabhi thoda effort hi humein physically aur mentally better feel karata hai.

**Because a healthy life is not about giving up all the comforts.
It is about making sure that our comforts don't take away our peace.** ❤️

title: Bachpan aur Ab
content:
Jab hum chhote hote hain na, tab kuch baatein hum realise hi nahi kar pate. Jo cheezein humein normal lagti hain, baad mein wahi samajh aati hain ki actually kitni special thi.

Mere ghar mein mummy, papa, main, mera bhai aur dadi rehte the. Mere liye toh woh bas ek family thi. Sabke beech pyaar tha, bonding thi, apnapan tha. Ghar mein main jaise chahe waise reh sakti thi. Mujhe kabhi kuch odd, awkward ya alag feel nahi hota tha.

Mujhe bas itna pata tha ki **main bhi is ghar ka ek member hoon.** Yeh ghar mera bhi hai. Main yahan apni baat keh sakti hoon, has sakti hoon, ro sakti hoon, zid kar sakti hoon, apni marzi se reh sakti hoon.

Mummy kabhi-kabhi gussa karti thi, daant deti thi… lekin us waqt mujhe lagta tha, *“Sabke parents kabhi-kabhi gussa karte hain. It's normal.”* Mujhe kabhi us gusse ke peeche koi aur meaning dhoondhne ki zarurat hi nahi padi.

Papa apni jagah the, mummy apni jagah, dadi ka apna role tha, bhai ke saath apni nok-jhok thi… aur in sabke beech mujhe kabhi yeh nahi laga ki mujhe apni jagah banani hai.

**Meri jagah already thi.**

Shayad bachpan ki sabse khoobsurat baat yahi hoti hai. Tab humein “belonging” ka meaning nahi pata hota, lekin hum use poori tarah feel kar rahe hote hain.

Aur shayad isi liye bachpan mein ghar sirf ek jagah nahi hota… ghar woh hota hai jahan aapko apna hone ka proof dene ki zarurat nahi padti.

Lekin shaadi ke itne saalon baad, aaj jab main apne bachchon ko dekhti hoon, toh ek aur cheez realise hoti hai.

Mere bachche bhi toh ek family setup mein hi bade ho rahe hain. Unke aas-paas bhi mummy, papa, dadi aur family ke doosre members hain. Aur main jitna chahti hoon ki unhe bhi wahi apnapan, wahi belonging aur wahi warmth mile jo maine apne bachpan mein feel ki thi… utna hi mujhe realise hota hai ki mere liye woh feeling create kar pana kitna mushkil hai.

Main apni MIL ke saath woh connection feel nahi kar pati.

Mujhe aksar lagta hai ki woh mujhe apne family member ki tarah accept hi nahi kar paati. Shayad mere baare mein unke mind mein kuch assumptions hain, kuch opinions hain… pata nahi kya-kya sochti rehti hain. Main unke liye kuch bhi karun, mujhe kabhi-kabhi lagta hai jaise usse unhe koi khaas farq hi nahi padta.

Unke liye shayad ye sab normal hai.

Shayad unhe lagta hai ki *bahuein aisi hi hoti hain*, aur ghar mein rehna hai toh ek-doosre ke saath jaise-taise manage karna hi padta hai.

Lekin mere liye family ka matlab sirf ek hi ghar mein rehna nahi hai.

Mere liye family ka matlab hai — **apnapan. Acceptance. Ye feeling ki main bhi is ghar ka utna hi hissa hoon jitna baaki sab.**

Mujhe unse koi special treatment nahi chahiye. Main ye bhi nahi chahti ki woh mujhe har baat par sahi samjhein.

Bas itna chahti hoon ki mujhe har waqt ye feel na ho ki main bahar se aayi hui koi insaan hoon jise is family mein adjust karna hai.

Main chahti hoon ki kabhi-kabhi woh mujhe bhi waise hi dekhein jaise maine apne ghar mein khud ko dekha tha — **apna.**

Aur shayad sabse zyada dukh isi baat ka hai ki itne saalon mein bhi main unhe ye baat samjha nahi paayi.

Maine bahut baar apni feelings explain karne ki koshish ki hogi, bahut kuch kaha hoga… lekin jo main actually chahti thi, shayad woh kabhi un tak pahunch hi nahi paaya.

Main unse sirf ek rishta nahi chahti thi.

**Main ek feeling chahti thi — ki main bhi family hoon.**

Aur aaj jab main apne bachchon ko dekhti hoon, toh kabhi-kabhi mann mein ek sawaal aata hai—

**Kya woh bhi bade hokar apne bachpan ko yaad karke ye feel karenge ki “haan, ye mera ghar tha… main is family ka ek hissa tha”?**

Shayad isi sawaal ne mujhe apne bachpan ko ek naye nazariye se dekhna sikhaya hai.

Tab jo mujhe normal lagta tha, aaj samajh aa raha hai ki woh kitna precious tha.

title: Festivals ka magic
content:
**Festivals ka ek alag hi magic hota hai… apne log thode aur yaad aane lagte hain. ❤️**

Rakhi ka festival aate hi ek alag si happiness hoti hai.

Bhai ke liye rakhi lena, sweets aur gift ready karna, aur phir uske saath video call ka wait karna…

Mera bhai India se bahar rehta hai. Har saal woh video call karta hai aur mere saamne hi apne haath mein rakhi baandhta hai.

Dekho toh sab kuch complete hota hai.

Rakhi bhi hai.
Mithai bhi hai.
Gift bhi hai.
Baaten bhi ho jaati hain.
Hansi-mazaak bhi ho jata hai.

Festival ki saari formalities poori ho jaati hain.

**Phir bhi… kuch missing sa lagta hai.**

Mujhe woh feeling bahut miss hoti hai jab main khud uske saamne baithkar uski kalai par rakhi baandhti thi.

Uska haath pakadna…
Rakhi baandhna…
Maathe par tilak lagana…
Mithai khilana…
Aur phir thodi der aur saath baithkar bina kisi khaas topic ke baatein karna…

Video call par face dikhai deta hai.
Awaaz sunai deti hai.
Hum hans bhi lete hain.

Lekin **woh touch, woh closeness, woh saamne hone ka feel… video call kabhi replace nahi kar sakti.**

Shayad isi liye festivals par apne log kuch zyada hi yaad aate hain.

Baaki dinon mein hum apni-apni life mein busy rehte hain—
work, ghar, responsibilities, daily routine…

Lekin festival aate hi purani memories jaise ek saath saamne aa jaati hain.

Woh ghar…
Woh saath baithna…
Woh chhoti-chhoti traditions…
Woh bina wajah hansna…
Aur woh apne log, jo ab kisi doosre shehar ya kisi doosre country mein hain.

Tab samajh aata hai…

**Festivals sirf sweets, gifts aur rituals ka naam nahi hain.
Festivals un logon ka naam hain, jinke saath hum un moments ko jeena chahte hain. ❤️**

Aur shayad isi liye, jab apne log door hote hain, toh khushi ke saath ek chhoti si udaasi bhi hoti hai.

Sab kuch hota hai…

**Bas unki presence nahi hoti. ❤️**

Is Rakhi par un sabhi brothers aur sisters ke liye jo ek-doosre se door rehkar festival celebrate kar rahe hain—

Distance chahe kitna bhi ho jaaye,

**kuch rishte hamesha wahi rehte hain… jahan humne unhe chhoda tha. ❤️**

#WomenKonnect #Rakhi #RakshaBandhan #SiblingLove #BrotherSisterBond #FamilyLove #Festivals #LongDistanceFamily #MissingLovedOnes #Memories #EmotionalMoments

title: Bachchon Ko Marks Nahi, Zindagi Ke Liye Taiyaar Karein
content:
Hello Friends. aaj mai bacho ko lekar thoda pareshan thi kyunki unke exams aane wale hain aur woh utna time nahi de rahe padai ko. I am presenting my thoughts as it is. 

Kya hum apne bachchon ko padhne ke liye kahen… ya bas unhe khush rehne dein?

Aaj ke bachchon ke paas uljhe rehne ke liye itni saari cheezein hain…

Internet hai, TV hai, YouTube hai, games hain, social media hai…
aur in sabke beech thoda sa waqt khelne ke liye bhi chahiye.

Phir hai padhai…
aur padhai ke saath woh endless competition.

Har taraf se ek hi baat sunai deti hai—
**“Aage badhna hai.”
“Achhe marks laane hain.”
“Peeche nahi rehna.”**

Lekin kabhi-kabhi bachchon par padhai ka pressure daalne se bhi darr lagta hai.

Aaj jab itni chhoti-chhoti baaton se bachchon ke stress aur mental health ko lekar khabrein sunne ko milti hain, toh dil kehta hai—
**kahin hum apne bachche se bahut zyada toh expect nahi kar rahe?**

Aur phir doosra darr saamne khada hota hai—
**agar humne use bilkul nahi roka, nahi samjhaya, padhai ke liye push nahi kiya… toh kahin woh sabse peeche na reh jaaye?**

Sach kahun toh kabhi-kabhi samajh hi nahi aata ki parenting ka sahi balance kya hai.

Na hum unka bachpan sirf marks aur competition mein khona chahte hain…
na hi hum chahte hain ki kal woh humse kahe—
**“Aapne mujhe time par samjhaya kyun nahi?”**

Ek interview mein Sushant Singh Rajput ne ek bahut interesting baat kahi thi, jiska thought mujhe aaj bhi sochne par majboor karta hai.

Unka kehna tha ki **aaj hum bachchon ko jis cheez ke liye prepare kar rahe hain, ho sakta hai future mein woh cheezein unke kaam hi na aayein. Aur future mein kya kaam aayega, ye hum aaj jaante bhi nahi.**

Toh phir hum unhe *exactly kya* padhayein?

Shayad iska jawab sirf syllabus aur marks mein nahi hai.

**Humein bachchon ko future ki har cheez ka jawab dene ke liye nahi,
future ke har challenge ka saamna karne ke liye ready karna hai.**

Unhe emotionally strong banana hai.

Unhe ye sikhana hai ki failure aaye toh woh toot na jaayein.
Kisi cheez mein success na mile toh woh khud ko unsuccessful na samjhein.
Mushkil waqt aaye toh woh usse bhaagein nahi, uska saamna karein.

Unhe problem-solving sikhani hai.
Unhe change ko accept karna sikhana hai.
Unhe apne decisions par sochna sikhana hai.
Aur sabse zaroori—
**unhe apne aap par bharosa karna sikhana hai.**

Kyuki hum ye predict nahi kar sakte ki unka future kaisa hoga.

Lekin hum unhe itna zaroor sikha sakte hain ki
**future chahe jaisa bhi ho, woh uske saamne khade reh sakein.**

Shayad parenting ka matlab ye nahi ki hum unke liye har raasta pehle se bana dein.

Shayad parenting ka matlab hai—
**unhe itna strong bana dein ki jab koi raasta na mile, toh woh khud ek raasta bana sakein. ❤️**

Aapko kya lagta hai?

**Kya aaj humein bachchon ko future ki specific race ke liye prepare karna chahiye, ya phir unhe life ke har challenge ka saamna karne layak banana chahiye?**

title: Dosti Jo Peeche Chhoot Gayi
content:
Hello Friends… Hope you all are doing fine.

Aaj main apni **friendship aur connections** ke baare mein share karna chahti hoon.

Shaadi se pehle meri do bahut achhi friends thi, jo 6th class se mere saath thi.

Hum almost roz milte the. Kabhi bahar ghoomne chale jaate, kabhi shaam ko saath walk karte, aur kabhi din mein bas yun hi ek-doosre ke ghar chale jaate.

Matlab… life mein ek simple sa routine tha, lekin usmein bahut saari khushiyan thi.

Hum aksar socha karte the ki shaadi ke baad bhi hamari dosti bilkul aisi hi rahegi.

Hum milte rahenge, baatein share karenge, kabhi ghoomne jayenge… aur hamari friendship mein kuch nahi badlega.

Lekin zindagi shayad humse zyada kuch jaanti thi.

Dheere-dheere sabki shaadi alag-alag jagah ho gayi.

Aur phir jo log kabhi almost roz milte the, unse milna **saalon mein kabhi-kabhi** ho paata hai.

Phone par baat karna bhi pehle jaisa nahi raha.

Shuru mein lagta tha ki time nahi mil raha, baad mein kar lenge…

Phir ghar, bachchon ki zimmedari, family aur rozmarra ki zindagi mein hum itne ulajhte gaye ki pata hi nahi chala ki hamari dosti kahin peeche chhoot gayi.

Kisi ne jaan-bujhkar dosti nahi chhodi thi.

Bas… **zindagi aage badhti gayi aur hum sab uske saath badhte gaye.**

Kabhi-kabhi sochti hoon, kitni ajeeb baat hai na?

Jin logon ke bina ek din bhi nahi guzarta tha, unse aaj baat karne ke liye bhi humein time nikalna padta hai.

Lekin shayad kuch connections aise hote hain jo roz baat na hone ke baad bhi dil mein kahin na kahin wahi rehte hain.

Dosti shayad hamesha saath rehne ka naam nahi hai…

Kabhi-kabhi dosti ka matlab sirf itna bhi hota hai ki **saalon baad milne par bhi lage—haan, kuch badla nahi.**

title: My Self-Discovery Journey
content:
Hello Friends… Hope you all are doing good.

Aaj main baat karne wali hoon apni **self-discovery** ke baare mein.

Aajkal ke bachchon ke paas explore karne ke liye bahut kuch hai. Unke paas itne options hain ki woh dekh-parakh sakte hain ki future mein unhe kya banna hai, kya achieve karna hai aur kis direction mein jaana hai.

Lekin mere time par aisa nahi tha.

Mujhe khud nahi pata tha ki mujhe kya banna hai. Bas teacher banne ka shauk tha, toh laga shayad mujhe teacher hi banna chahiye. Koshish bhi ki… lekin aakhir mein maine woh decision chhodne ka le liya.

Uske baad maine alag-alag tarah ki jobs bhi ki, lekin main kisi mein properly survive nahi kar paayi.

Aur shayad sabse badi problem ye thi ki main **khud par yakin hi nahi karti thi.**

Log mere baare mein jo bhi baatein karte, main unhe sun leti thi aur wahi sach maan leti thi.

Mujhe lagta tha ki doosre log mujhse zyada samajhdar hain. Isliye woh jo bhi keh rahe hain, wahi sahi hoga… aur shayad meri soch hi galat hai.

Khud ki baat par kabhi poora bharosa nahi tha.

Isi uljhan mein maine kuch galat decisions bhi liye.

Lekin zindagi sirf galtiyan nahi karwati… **woh un galtiyon se seekhne ka mauka bhi deti hai.**

Dheere-dheere zindagi ne mujhe bahut se sabak sikhaye.

Aur ek din mujhe ye samajh aaya ki…

**Doosron ki kahi har baat sahi nahi hoti, aur meri har baat galat bhi nahi hoti.**

Bas yahin se shayad meri real self-discovery shuru hui.

Maine dheere-dheere apni baaton ko bhi importance dena shuru kiya.

Apne decisions ke liye har kisi ko convince karna chhod diya.

Maine ye samajhna shuru kiya ki agar main apne decisions ki zimmedari khud le rahi hoon, toh har decision ke liye mujhe sabki approval ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Aur interesting baat ye hai ki jab maine khud ko seriously lena shuru kiya, toh log bhi dheere-dheere meri position samajhne lage.

Woh bhi usi hisaab se adjust hone lage, jis tarah maine unke saath apni boundaries aur apna behaviour set kiya.

Aaj bhi main professionally shayad kuch bahut bada nahi hoon.

Lekin as a person…

**Maine khud mein bahut growth dekhi hai.**

Aaj main apni baat sun sakti hoon.

Apne decisions par bharosa kar sakti hoon.

Aur sabse important…

**Mujhe har baar khud ko sahi saabit karne ki zaroorat mehsoos nahi hoti.**

Shayad mere liye…

**yahi meri achievement hai.**

Aur shayad self-discovery ka matlab bhi yahi hai—

ki ek din aapko duniya se zyada nahi,
**khud se milna zaroori lagne lage.**

title: Shadi ke baad...
content:
Hello Friends,

I hope aap sab achhe honge. Aaj main aapse kuch baatein share karna chahti hoon. Ye mere kuch personal thoughts hain, kuch aisi feelings jo main aksar feel karti hoon. Shayad aap mein se kuch log bhi in feelings se connect kar paayen.

Hamari life mein shaadi ke baad kitna bada change aata hai, ye samajhna bhi mushkil hai aur kisi ko samjhana bhi. Shaadi se pehle humein bachchon ki tarah rakha jaata hai. Hamare nakhre uthaye jaate hain, hamari chhoti-chhoti zarooraton ka khayal rakha jaata hai aur bina kisi wajah ke bhi bahut pyaar milta hai.

Shaadi ke baad bhi pyaar milta hai, bilkul milta hai… lekin kabhi-kabhi us pyaar ka roop badal jaata hai.

Pehle sirf **hamara hona** hi humein pyaar karne ke liye kaafi hota tha. Lekin shaadi ke baad kabhi-kabhi aisa lagta hai ki hamara hona tab zyada important ho jaata hai jab hum kisi ki zaroorat poori kar rahe hon, kisi ka khayal rakh rahe hon, ghar sambhal rahe hon… aur ye sab sirf ek-do din nahi, balki long term tak karte rahein.

Tab shayad humein ek achhi wife, bahu ya partner ke roop mein dekha jaata hai.

Aur kabhi-kabhi mann mein ye bhi thought aata hai—**“Hum to ise bahut pyaar se rakhte hain.”**

Main responsibilities ki importance ko bilkul deny nahi kar rahi. Zimmedariyan life ka part hain aur har relationship mein hoti hain. Lekin kabhi-kabhi in responsibilities ke beech jo **emotional gap** aa jaata hai, woh hurt karta hai.

Shaadi ke baad jab hum apne ghar, yani mayke jaate hain, to sab kuch wahi hota hai… wahi room, wahi log, wahi ghar. Lekin pata nahi kyun, woh pehle wali feeling nahi reh jaati.

Parents bhi shayad ye sochne lagte hain ki **“Do chaar din ke liye aayi hai, phir chali jaayegi.”**

Aur dheere-dheere humein bhi apne hi ghar mein kabhi-kabhi ek mehmaan jaisi feeling aane lagti hai.

Sabse ajeeb baat ye hai ki sasural mein jab hum saare kaam apne haathon se karte hain, har cheez ki responsibility humse judi hoti hai, to kabhi-kabhi wahi jagah apne ghar jaisi lagne lagti hai.

Shayad isliye kyunki wahan hum kisi aur se expect hi nahi karte.

Wahan sabki expectations humse judi hoti hain.

Aur mayke mein, jahan kabhi humse kuch expect nahi kiya jaata tha, jahan sirf hamara hona hi kaafi tha… wahan shaadi ke baad kabhi-kabhi humein lagta hai ki hum ab pehle jaise belong nahi karte.

Ye baat shayad logically samajhna easy nahi hai. Aur shayad main bhi ise utni achhi tarah explain nahi kar pa rahi hoon jitna feel karti hoon.

Kabhi-kabhi main bahut emotional ho jaati hoon ye sab sochkar.

Shayad problem kisi ek insaan ki nahi hai. Shayad ye life ke badalne ka ek aisa phase hai jahan **ghar wahi rehte hain, log wahi rehte hain… bas hamari jagah aur hamare hone ka ehsaas badal jaata hai.**

Aur shayad jinhone ye feeling kabhi mehsoos ki hai, woh bina zyada explanation ke samajh jaayenge ki main kya kehna chahti hoon. ❤️

title: आख़िरी समय में सिर्फ़ 5100 रुपये…
content:
आज मोबाइल पर रील देखते-देखते एक ऐसी कहानी सामने आ गई, जिसने मुझे सोचने पर मजबूर कर दिया।

हम आज अपने बच्चों के सपने पूरे करने के लिए दिन-रात मेहनत कर रहे हैं।
हमें नहीं पता कि कल हमारे बच्चे हमारे लिए कितना समय निकालेंगे…
लेकिन हमें यह ज़रूर पता है कि **हम अपनी तरफ़ से कोई कमी नहीं छोड़ना चाहते।**

अच्छी पढ़ाई मिले, अच्छा भविष्य मिले, अच्छी ज़िंदगी मिले…
इसके लिए माता-पिता अपनी कितनी इच्छाएँ कुर्बान कर देते हैं।

उस पिता ने भी शायद यही किया होगा।

उनके दो बेटे थे। दोनों विदेश में रहते थे और बहुत पैसे वाले थे।
लेकिन पिता अपनी ज़िंदगी के आख़िरी दिनों में एक वृद्धाश्रम में थे।

फिर एक दिन उनका निधन हो गया।

वृद्धाश्रम के संचालक ने बड़े बेटे को फोन किया…
उसने फोन तक नहीं उठाया।

छोटे बेटे ने फोन उठाया तो उसे बताया गया आपके पिता अब नहीं रहे। अंतिम संस्कार के लिए आप कब तक आ पाएँगे? हम आपका इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं।

बेटे ने जवाब दिया मेरे पास समय नहीं है। मैं ₹5100 भेज देता हूँ, आप लोग सब कर दीजिएगा। पैसे और चाहिए हों तो बता देना।

संचालक ने कहा कम से कम वीडियो कॉल पर तो आ जाइए…
लेकिन वह बेटा वहाँ भी ज़्यादा देर रुककर अपने पिता को आख़िरी बार देख नहीं पाया…
और फोन काट दिया।

वृद्धाश्रम के लोगों ने उसके भेजे हुए पैसे वापस कर दिए और कहा—

इनका सब कुछ हम करेंगे…
क्योंकि ये हमारे लिए सिर्फ़ एक बुज़ुर्ग नहीं, हमारे अपने थे।

उस दिन शायद उस पिता को पैसों की नहीं…
अपने बच्चों की ज़रूरत थी।

इसलिए बच्चों को सिर्फ़ पढ़ाई, पैसा और कामयाबी मत दीजिए…
उन्हें यह भी सिखाइए कि
माँ-बाप की ज़िंदगी में उनकी सबसे बड़ी ज़रूरत उनका समय और उनका साथ होता है।

क्योंकि एक दिन पैसा बहुत होगा…
लेकिन हो सकता है माँ-बाप न हों।

अपने माता-पिता के पास बैठ जाइए…
जब तक उनके पास बैठने का समय आपके पास है।

title: Sach Kahun... Mujhe Khud Se Mile Hue Bahut Saal Ho Gaye.
content:
Kabhi-kabhi raat ko sabke so jaane ke baad...

Main chupchaap balcony mein baith jaati hoon.

Hawa chalti rehti hai...

Par mere andar ajeeb si khamoshi hoti hai.

Main sochti hoon...

**Aakhir main hoon kaun?**

Pehle main kisi ki beti thi...

Phir kisi ki bahu ban gayi...

Phir kisi ki wife...

Phir mummy...

Aur in sab rishton ke beech...

Pata hi nahi chala...

**"Main"... kahin peeche reh gayi.**

Aaj bhi subah sabse pehle meri hi aankh khulti hai.

Sabke din ki shuruaat meri wajah se hoti hai...

Aur mera din...

Kab shuru hota hai aur kab khatam...

Ye shayad mujhe bhi nahi pata.

Kabhi kisi ki chai...

Kabhi kisi ka tiffin...

Kabhi kisi ka towel...

Kabhi kisi ki file...

Kabhi kisi ki dawai...

Poora din bas ek hi awaaz sunai deti hai...

**"Mummy..."**

**"Suno..."**

**"Zara ek minute..."**

Aur mazedaar baat pata hai?

Poore ghar mein agar ek clip bhi kho jaaye...

To sabko lagta hai...

**Mummy ko hi pata hoga.** 😊

Sach mein...

Mujhe sabki har cheez ki jagah yaad rehti hai.

Bas...

Apni khushiyon ki jagah bhool gayi hoon.

Ek din almari saaf karte waqt mera purana purse mila.

Uske andar ek chhoti si chitthi thi...

Jo maine khud ko college ke dino mein likhi thi.

Usme likha tha...

**"Kabhi apne sapne mat chhodna."**

Woh padhte hi meri aankhon se aansu nikal aaye.

Main sapne bhooli nahi thi...

Bas har baar unse kehti rahi...

**"Thoda aur ruk jao..."**

Bachche bade ho jaayein...

Ghar settle ho jaaye...

Thodi savings ho jaaye...

Phir jee loongi.

Lekin...

Woh "phir" kabhi aaya hi nahi.

Ek din meri beti ne achanak pooch liya...

**"Mummy... aapko sabse zyada kya pasand hai?"**

Main chup ho gayi.

Mere paas jawab hi nahi tha.

Main sabki pasand bata sakti thi...

Par apni...

Nahi.

Us din pehli baar mujhe apne upar taras nahi...

Daya bhi nahi...

Bas ek ehsaas hua...

**Main khud ko hi jeena bhool gayi hoon.**

Us din maine koi bada faisla nahi liya.

Bas apne liye ek cup garam chai banayi...

Aur use bina jaldi kiye aaram se piya.

Saalon baad...

Chai ka taste mehsoos hua.

Phir dheere-dheere maine roz thoda sa waqt apne liye nikalna shuru kiya.

Kabhi diary likhi...

Kabhi purane gaane sune...

Kabhi terrace par khade hokar bas aasman dekha.

Aur pata hai?

Ghar toot nahi gaya.

Khana bhi ban gaya.

Kapde bhi dhul gaye.

Bas ek cheez badal gayi...

**Main phir se muskuraane lagi.**

Aaj bhi main wahi homemaker hoon.

Aaj bhi poora ghar sambhalti hoon.

Lekin ab ek farq hai...

Ab main apni muskaan ko bhi ghar ka hissa maanti hoon.

Kyuki mujhe samajh aa gaya hai...

**Jo aurat khud ko hi bhool jaati hai... woh ek din andar se khaali ho jaati hai.**

Aur jo aurat khud ko phir se dhoond leti hai...

Woh sirf apni nahi...

Poore ghar ki zindagi badal deti hai.

Isliye aaj...

Agar aapse koi pooche...

**"Tum kaun ho?"**

To sirf itna mat kehna...

**"Main housewife hoon."**

Muskura kar kehna...

**"Main ek aisi aurat hoon jo apne parivaar se bahut pyaar karti hai... aur ab khud se bhi."** ❤️

title: Sab Bhool Gaye...
content:
Kabhi-kabhi zindagi humein itna emotional kar deti hai ki hum bina wajah hi kuch baatein maan lete hain।

Pichhle saal mera birthday tha।

Subah uthi to har din ki tarah kitchen mein chali gayi। Chai banayi, bachchon ka tiffin tayyar kiya, husband ka breakfast banaya, sabko unke kaam par bhej diya।

Poore ghar mein sab kuch bilkul normal tha...

Aur shayad isi baat ne mujhe tod diya।

Dil mein baar-baar ek hi khayal aa raha tha...

"Shayad sab mera birthday bhool gaye."

Main phone ko baar-baar dekhti...

Har notification par lagta shayad husband ka message hoga।

Har baar doorbell bajti to lagta shayad koi surprise hoga।

Lekin kuch bhi nahi।

Dopahar tak kisi ne ek baar bhi "Happy Birthday" nahi kaha।

Main khud ko samjhati rahi...

"Housewife ka birthday bhi koi yaad rakhta hai kya..."

Us din maine bhi kisi ko yaad nahi dilaya।

Socha...

Agar yaad dilakar wish karwana pade, to us wish ki khushi hi kya।

Shaam ko bachche school se aaye। Hamesha ki tarah maine unke liye snacks banaye, homework karwaya aur phir dinner ki taiyari mein lag gayi।

Dil bahut udaas tha...

Lekin chehre par wahi roz wali muskurahat thi।

Raat ko husband ne kaha,

"Aaj khana thoda jaldi bana dena."

Maine mann hi mann socha...

"Inhe to sach mein yaad hi nahi."

Jab sabne khana kha liya, maine kitchen saaf ki aur apne kamre ki taraf jaane lagi।

Tabhi...

Poore ghar ki lights band ho gayi।

Main ghabra gayi।

Usse pehle ki main kuch samajh paati...

Door dheere se khula।

Aur andhere mein ek chhoti si candle ki roshni nazar aayi।

Mere dono bachche cake lekar khade the...

Aur unke peeche husband muskura rahe the।

Sab ek saath zor se bole...

"Happy Birthday Mummy!" ❤️

Main kuch pal ke liye bilkul chup ho gayi।

Meri aankhon se aansu apne aap behne lage।

Husband ne muskura kar kaha,

"Poora din isliye kuch nahi bola... kyunki is baar tumhe surprise dena tha."

Phir unhone ek baat kahi...

Jo main shayad kabhi nahi bhool paungi।

"Tum roz hum sabki khushiyon ka khayal rakhti ho... ek din to sirf tumhare naam hona chahiye."

Us pal mujhe ehsaas hua...

Kabhi-kabhi hum jaldi hi yeh maan lete hain ki log humein bhool gaye।

Jabki woh chupchaap hamare chehre par muskaan lane ki taiyari kar rahe hote hain।

Us raat cake ka taste ya gift yaad nahi raha...

Bas itna yaad raha...

Ki jis aurat ko laga tha uska birthday sab bhool gaye... uske liye uske apne poora din ek surprise sambhal kar baithe the।

Us din samajh aaya...

Pyaar har baar shabdon se nahi dikhaya jaata... kabhi-kabhi ek chhota sa surprise bhi saalon ki thakan mita deta hai। ❤️🎂

title: Main Ghar Ka Budget Sambhalti Hoon... Aur Sach Kahun, Ye Kisi MBA Se Kam Nahi!
content:
Har mahine ki pehli tareekh aati hai...

Aur log sochte hain...

**"Salary aa gayi... ab toh maze hi maze!"**

Lekin meri kahani thodi alag hai.

Salary account mein aate hi mere dimaag mein calculator automatic ON ho jaata hai.

Ek haath mein diary...

Doosre haath mein mobile ka calculator...

Aur chehre par wahi expression...

**"Hey Bhagwan... is baar bhi poora mahina nikalwa dena."** 😅

Sabse pehle list banti hai...

Kirana...

Bijli ka bill...

Gas...

School fees...

Doodh...

Internet recharge...

Medicines...

Aur phir bache hue paise ko dekhkar lagta hai...

**"Accha... toh isi mein poora mahina chalana hai."**

Mere husband kabhi-kabhi bade pyaar se bol dete hain...

**"Yaar... is mahine thoda budget loose rakhte hain."**

Main sirf unki taraf dekh kar muskura deti hoon.

Unhe kya pata...

Budget loose hua...

Toh mahine ke last week mein chai ke saath biscuit bhi luxury lagne lagenge! 😂

Sabzi mandi jaana bhi kisi adventure movie se kam nahi hota.

Main 5 rupaye kam karane ke liye itni negotiation karti hoon...

Jaise koi international deal final kar rahi hoon.

Aur ghar aakar proudly bolti hoon...

**"Aaj 40 rupaye bacha liye."**

Phir wahi 40 rupaye ka online delivery charge dekhkar order cancel bhi kar deti hoon. 🤭

Kabhi apne liye koi suit pasand aa jaata hai.

Price dekhti hoon...

Dil kehta hai...

**"Le le... kitna sundar hai."**

Dimaag kehta hai...

**"Is paise mein bachchon ke do T-shirt aa jayenge."**

Aur main...

Screenshot lekar gallery mein save kar leti hoon.

Jaise gallery mein save karne se suit mera ho gaya ho. 😂

Kabhi bachcha chocolate maang leta hai...

Kabhi husband bolte hain...

**"Is Sunday bahar khana kha lete hain."**

Aur main turant hisaab lagati hoon...

**"Agar is hafte bahar khayenge... toh agle hafte paneer ki jagah aloo hi hero banega."** 😄

Sabko lagta hai main bahut kanjoos hoon.

Par sach bataun...

Main kanjoos nahi hoon...

Main bas future ki tension aaj hi le leti hoon.

Kabhi fridge khol kar sochti hoon...

**"Is aadhe pyaaz, do tamatar aur thodi si shimla mirch se aaj kya naya banaun?"**

Aur jab family khana kha kar bolti hai...

**"Waah! Aaj toh bahut tasty bana hai."**

Toh lagta hai...

MasterChef ki trophy mujhe hi milni chahiye. 😄❤️

Mahine ke aakhri 5 din toh alag hi level ke hote hain.

Wallet kholne se pehle hi dil dhadakne lagta hai.

Aur purse mein rakhe 200 rupaye bhi itne pyaare lagte hain...

Jaise woh 20,000 hon.

Kabhi-kabhi main bhi sochti hoon...

Ek baar bina price dekhe shopping karun...

Restaurant mein menu ka right side na dekhun...

Apne liye bhi bina guilt ke kuch kharid loon...

Lekin phir bachchon ki fees yaad aa jaati hai...

Ghar ki zarooratein yaad aa jaati hain...

Aur meri khwahish phir agle mahine tak postpone ho jaati hai.

Sach kahun...

Ghar chalana sirf khana banana nahi hota.

Har din naye decisions lena padta hai.

Kab kis cheez par kharch karna hai...

Kab kis cheez ko rokna hai...

Kab apni khwahish chhod kar kisi aur ki khushi khareedni hai.

Aur ye sab karte-karte pata hi nahi chalta...

Kab bachche bade ho jaate hain...

Kab safed baal aa jaate hain...

Kab apni pasand ka rang bhi yaad nahi rehta.

Lekin ek baat aaj bhi dil ko sukoon deti hai...

Mahine ke aakhri din bhi jab ghar mein rashan hota hai...

Bachchon ke chehre par muskaan hoti hai...

Aur kisi ko kisi cheez ki kami mehsoos nahi hoti...

Toh main chupchaap Bhagwan ka shukriya karti hoon.

Kyuki us din lagta hai...

**Mera budget nahi... meri dua kaam aa gayi.**

Log kehte hain...

**"Tum toh sirf ghar sambhalti ho."**

Main bas muskura deti hoon.

Kyunki mujhe pata hai...

Main sirf ghar nahi sambhalti...

Main har mahine sapne, zarooratein, emotions aur poore parivaar ki khushiyan balance karti hoon.

Aur sach kahun...

**Har homemaker ke paas degree ho ya na ho... lekin life ka sabse bada MBA uske experience mein hota hai.** ❤️

title: Uski Koi Chhutti Nahi Hoti...
content:
Subah ke 5 baje alarm bajne se pehle hi meri aankh khul jaati hai।

Sabse pehle kitchen... phir chai... bachchon ke tiffin... husband ka breakfast... school ki uniform... ghar ki safai... doodh wala... sabzi wala... kapde washing machine mein... aur dekhte hi dekhte subah ke 10 baj jaate hain।

Tab tak ghar ke baaki log apne-apne kaam par nikal chuke hote hain।

Koi office...

Koi school...

Aur main?

Main phir bhi kaam par hi hoti hoon।

Bas farq itna hai ki meri office ka naam **"Ghar"** hai।

Meri salary nahi aati...

Meri promotion nahi hoti...

Mujhe koi appraisal letter nahi milta...

Aur na hi kabhi koi Sunday, festival ya public holiday।

Mujhe yaad bhi nahi ki aakhri baar maine kab bina kisi fikr ke ek cup chai garam-garam baithkar pi thi।

Mera khana aksar sabke khane ke baad hota hai...

Aur kai baar to thanda hi kha leti hoon।

Kabhi bachche bula lete hain...

Kabhi kisi ko kuch chahiye hota hai...

Aur meri plate phir se chhoot jaati hai।

Agar mujhe bukhar ho tab bhi khana banana hota hai।

Sar dard ho tab bhi bachchon ka homework dekhna hota hai।

Apna mann udaas ho tab bhi sabke saamne muskurana padta hai।

Kabhi-kabhi aankhon mein aansu hote hain...

Lekin unhe pochhne ka bhi waqt nahi hota।

Kyuki cooker ki seeti baj rahi hoti hai...

Doorbell baj rahi hoti hai...

Ya kisi ko awaaz lagani hoti hai—

**"Mummy..."**

Aur bas...

Maa phir apne dard ko dil ke kisi kone mein rakh deti hai।

Kabhi-kabhi sochti hoon...

Agar main ek din ke liye bhi ghar ka kaam chhod doon, to shayad sabko pata chal jaaye ki main poora din karti kya hoon।

Lekin phir agle hi pal dil kehta hai...

"Nahi... bachchon ko pareshani hogi."

Shayad isi ko maa hona kehte hain।

Apni thakan se pehle sabki zarurat dekhna।

Apni khwahishon se pehle sabki khushi rakhna।

Mujhe yaad nahi ki maine apne liye aakhri baar kya kharida tha...

Lekin mujhe bachchon ki favourite chocolate ka flavour yaad hai...

Husband ki shirt ka size yaad hai...

Saas-sasur ki dawai ka time yaad hai...

Bas...

Apni pasand kab ki bhool chuki hoon।

Sab ke birthdays yaad rehte hain...

Anniversary yaad rehti hai...

School meetings yaad rehti hain...

Par kabhi-kabhi apni khud ki muskaan kab kho gayi...

Yeh yaad nahi rehta।

Aur sabse zyada dard tab hota hai...

Jab koi hansi mein keh deta hai—

**"Tum karti hi kya ho? Ghar par hi to rehti ho."**

Us pal dil to bahut rota hai...

Par chehre par bas ek muskaan aa jaati hai।

Kyunki safai dene se zyada zaroori hota hai...

Shaam ka khana banana।

Maine kabhi salary nahi maangi...

Na hi kisi medal ki umeed ki।

Bas kabhi-kabhi dil chahta hai ki koi peeche se aakar itna keh de—

**"Aaj tum baith jao... aaj main sab sambhal leta hoon."**

Ya phir...

**"Thank you... tumhari wajah se hi yeh ghar ghar lagta hai."**

Yakeen maaniye...

Yeh do shabd kisi bhi mehange tohfe se kahin zyada keemti hote hain।

Hum auratein kamzor nahi hoti...

Bas apni takleef chhupa leti hain।

Hum thakti bhi hain...

Tootti bhi hain...

Kabhi bathroom mein chupkar ro bhi leti hain...

Phir muh dho kar bahar aa jaati hain...

Taaki bachchon ko lage—

**"Mummy to hamesha theek rehti hain."**

Lekin sach yeh hai...

**Mummy bhi insaan hoti hai।**

Uska bhi dil hota hai...

Uske bhi sapne hote hain...

Usse bhi kabhi sirf do pal ki chhutti aur thoda sa apnapan chahiye hota hai।

Kyunki...

**Ek ghar sirf eent aur cement se nahi banta...**

**Ek aurat ki khamosh mehnat, uske bina shart pyaar aur har roz ki chhoti-chhoti kurbaniyon se banta hai।**

Aur shayad isi liye...

**Duniya ki sabse mushkil job ka koi appointment letter nahi hota... aur uski kabhi retirement bhi nahi hoti।** ❤️

title: Ek Promotion, Do Raaste
content:
Main hamesha se apne kaam ko lekar bahut serious rahi hoon। Padhai khatam karne ke baad jab pehli job mili thi, tab lagta tha ki bas apni pehchaan banani hai aur kuch kar dikhana hai। Dheere-dheere mehnat rang laane lagi। Office mein meri performance achhi thi aur seniors bhi mere kaam ki tareef karte the।

Ek din office mein mujhe promotion offer hua।

Woh meri zindagi ka sabse khushiyon bhara pal hona chahiye tha। Saalon ki mehnat, overtime, deadlines aur sacrifices ka phal mujhe mil raha tha।

Lekin ek shart thi...

Promotion ke saath mujhe doosre shehar shift hona tha।

Office se ghar lautte waqt mere dimaag mein hazaaron khayal chal rahe the। Ek taraf mera sapna tha, doosri taraf mera parivaar।

Jab maine ghar par yeh baat batayi, to sab khush hone ke bajay pareshan ho gaye।

"Kya zarurat hai itni door jaane ki?"

"Yahan bhi to job kar rahi ho।"

"Ladki hokar akele kaise rahogi?"

"Career sab kuch nahi hota।"

Har kisi ke paas mujhe rokne ki ek wajah thi।

Us raat main bahut royi।

Mujhe laga jaise mujhe apne sapnon aur apne parivaar mein se kisi ek ko chunna padega।

Main apne kamre mein baithi purani tasveerein dekh rahi thi। College ke din yaad aa gaye, jab main bade sapne dekha karti thi। Tab main har kisi se kehti thi ki ek din kuch bada karungi, apne dam par apni pehchaan banaungi।

Phir maine khud se ek sawaal poocha...

**Agar aaj main darr kar peeche hat gayi, to kya zindagi bhar khud ko maaf kar paungi?**

Jawab tha — **Nahi।**

Agli subah maine himmat karke apne papa se baat ki।

Maine kaha, "Mujhe darr lag raha hai... par mujhe lagta hai ki mujhe yeh mauka lena chahiye।"

Kuch pal ki khamoshi ke baad papa ne bas itna kaha,

**"Sapne dekhne ka hausla rakha hai, to unhe poora karne ka hausla bhi rakho। Hum hamesha tumhare saath hain।"**

Unki yeh baat sunkar meri aankhon mein aansu aa gaye।

Us din mujhe samajh aaya ki kabhi-kabhi sabse mushkil ladai duniya se nahi, apne darr se hoti hai।

Maine promotion accept kar liya।

Naye shehar mein shuruaat aasaan nahi thi। Akelapan tha, challenges the, kai baar ghar ki yaad mein royi bhi। Lekin har mushkil ke saath mera confidence bhi badhta gaya।

Kuch saal baad jab mujhe company ke annual event mein award mila aur stage se maine apne parents ko audience mein muskuraate dekha...

Tab samajh aaya ki maine sirf promotion nahi accept kiya tha।

Maine apne sapnon ko ek mauka diya tha।

Aur aaj mujhe yakeen hai...

**Ek aurat jab apne sapnon ke liye khadi hoti hai, to woh sirf apni zindagi nahi badalti, balki aane wali kai ladkiyon ke liye raasta bhi banati hai।** ❤️✨

title: Mayke Se Wapas Aana Hamesha Mushkil Hota Hai
content:
Aaj ghar wapas jaane ka din hai। Bachchon ke school khulne wale hain, summer vacations khatam ho gayi hain aur ab chahe dil kare ya na kare, apne ghar lautna hi hoga।
