Har saal sochti hoon ki bas 10-15 din ke liye ja rahi hoon, lekin pata nahi ye kuch din itni jaldi kaise nikal jaate hain। Lagta hai jaise kal hi to aayi thi aur aaj phir se packing chal rahi hai।

Sach kahun to mayka mere liye ek recharge station jaisa hai। Yahan aakar lagta hai ki poore saal ki thakan, tension aur zimmedariyan kuch dino ke liye door ho gayi hain। Maa ke haath ka khana, apne kamre ki yaadein, bina kisi planning ke chai par ghanton baatein... sab kuch dil ko sukoon deta hai।

Aur agar bhai-bhabhi acche mil jaayein, to sach mein sone pe suhaga ho jata hai। ❤️

Phir wahi bachpan ki baatein nikal aati hain। Kaise hum chhoti-chhoti baaton par ladte the, kaise ek doosre ki chocolates chura kar kha jaate the, kaise mummy ki daant se bachne ke liye ek team ban jaate the। 😄

Sabse accha lagta hai jab bhai-behan phir se ek jagah baithkar gappe maarte hain। Koi mobile nahi, koi formalities nahi... bas purani yaadein, hansi-mazaak aur apnapan। Kuch der ke liye lagta hai ki hum phir se wahi bachche ban gaye hain, jinhe na kal ki chinta thi aur na zimmedariyon ka bojh।

Lekin phir ek din packing shuru ho jaati hai। Suitcase mein kapde rakhte-rakhte dil bhi thoda bhaari ho jata hai। Maa baar-baar poochti hain, "Sab rakh liya na?" Aur hum baar-baar sochte hain, "Kaash thode din aur ruk paate।"

Par zindagi ka bhi apna niyam hai। Betiyan chahe kitni bhi badi ho jaayein, mayka kabhi chhootta nahi... aur sasural chahe kitna bhi apna ho jaaye, mayke se wapas aate waqt aankhen hamesha thodi nam ho hi jaati hain।

Chalo, ab phir se wahi routine, wahi school, wahi responsibilities...

Lekin dil mein mayke ke pyaar aur yaadon ka ek naya recharge lekar। ❤️🏡

title: collage Days
content:
Aaj meri choti behan ka college mein admission ho gaya। Use college ke liye excited dekhkar mujhe bhi apne college ke din yaad aa gaye। Sach kahun to zindagi ke sabse khoobsurat aur befikr din wahi the।

Classes se zyada excitement doston se milne ki hoti thi। Lecture shuru hone se pehle hi canteen mein chai aur samose ke saath poori duniya ki baatein ho jaati thi। Group studies ke naam par kitaben khuli rehti thi aur baatein zyada hoti thi। 😄

Exam ke ek din pehle sabko notes yaad aate the। Ek dost ke notes poori class mein ghoomte the aur sab uski photocopy karwane mein lage rehte the। Aur result aane ke baad wahi log kehte the, "Yaar mujhe to kuch aata hi nahi tha!" 😂

Delhi University ke elections to kisi festival se kam nahi hote the। Aisa lagta tha jaise desh ke PM ka election chal raha ho। Har jagah posters, speeches, pamphlets aur campaigning। Kuch log to free pens aur chocolates lekar hi vote decide kar lete the। 😆

Aur college fest... uska to alag hi craze tha। Poora group bana kar alag-alag colleges ke fest attend karna, dance performances dekhna, celebrity nights enjoy karna, food stalls par paise uda dena aur phir ghar aakar kehna, "Aaj to bas padhai hi ki hai।" 😜

Kabhi bunk maar kar movie dekhne chale jana, kabhi attendance short hone par teachers ke saamne emotional speech dena, kabhi assignment submission ke din poori raat jagna... aur phir bhi har din mazedaar lagta tha।

Us waqt lagta tha ki college kab khatam hoga aur hum bade honge। Lekin aaj samajh aata hai ki zindagi ka sabse accha hissa wahi tha। Na bills ki tension, na responsibilities ka bojh... bas dosti, masti, sapne aur thodi si padhai।

Aaj behan ko college jaate dekhkar dil se dua nikli ki woh bhi apni zindagi ke ye khoobsurat pal khulkar jiye, acche dost banaye aur aisi yaadein ikatthi kare jo 20 saal baad bhi chehre par muskaan le aayein। ❤️🎓

title: Aaj Father's Day hai..
content:
Main apne papa ke saath hoon, unka haath thaam sakti hoon, unse baat kar sakti hoon। Lekin phir bhi dil mein ek ajeeb si kami hai। Kyunki mera bhai mere saath nahi hai।

Bhai, aaj ka din aapke bina adhoora lagta hai। Aap sirf mere bade bhai nahi the, kai baar ek pita ki tarah mere saath khade rahe। Jab papa kuch nahi keh paate the, tab aap samajh jaate the। Jab main tootne lagti thi, tab aap sambhal lete the। Aapne hamesha care ki, support diya aur har mushkil mein mere saath khade rahe।

Aaj jab log Father's Day celebrate kar rahe hain, mujhe aapki bahut yaad aa rahi hai।

Kabhi-kabhi sochti hoon...

Ek pita woh bhi hota hai jo itni door chala jaata hai ki phir kabhi apne bachchon ke paas wapas nahi aa sakta।

Ek pita woh bhi hota hai jo apne bete ke bina Father's Day mana raha hota hai aur dil hi dil mein toot raha hota hai।

Aur ek pita woh bhi hota hai jo zinda to hota hai, paas bhi ho sakta hai... lekin apne ego, apni zid ya apni khamoshi ki wajah se apne bachchon tak nahi pahunch pata।

Shayad pehle ka zamana hi theek tha...

Na Father's Day hota tha, na Mother's Day...

Har din maa-baap ka hota tha।

Aaj social media par sab wishes likh dete hain, photos laga dete hain... lekin jin logon ke paas maa-baap hain, woh aksar unki kadar nahi karte।

Aur jin ke paas nahi hain...

Woh unki purani tasveerein dekh kar chupke se ro lete hain।

Koi milna chahta hai par mil nahi sakta...

Koi mil sakta hai, par milna hi nahi chahta...

Aur kuch log aise bhi hote hain jo har saal bas ek kami ke saath jeete rehte hain।

Ajab zindagi hai...

Kuch rishte paas hote hue bhi door ho jaate hain, aur kuch door hokar bhi dil mein hamesha zinda rehte hain।

Bas phir bhi jeena padta hai...

Jaisi bhi zindagi ho, jaise bhi halaat ho...

Yaadon ko seene se lagakar, muskurahat ka chehra pehenkar...

Bas jeete jaana padta hai। ❤️

title: Barish Mein Aayi Woh Aakhri Pukar"
content:
Yeh kahani itni ajeeb hai ki shayad bahut se log is par yakeen na karein. Kabhi-kabhi mujhe khud bhi lagta hai ki shayad yeh meri aankhon ka dhokha tha... lekin jo hua, uske baad aaj tak mere paas uska koi jawab nahi hai।

Us din shaam ko main apni dost ke saath office se ghar laut rahi thi। Mausam achanak kharab ho gaya। Tez baarish ke saath aandhi aur tufaan bhi shuru ho gaya। Visibility itni kam ho gayi thi ki aage ka raasta mushkil se dikh raha tha।

Maine car road ke kinare rok di। Meri dost baar-baar keh rahi thi, "Yahan mat ruko, area bahut sunsaan hai।" Lekin us tufaan mein gaadi chalana mujhe aur zyada khatarnak lag raha tha।

Tabhi achanak...

**Thak... Thak... Thak...**

Kisi ne car ki window par zor-zor se khatkhataaya।

Hum dono buri tarah ghabra gaye।

Bahar ek aurat khadi thi। Baarish uske chehre par beh rahi thi। Uski aankhon mein itni bechaini thi ki aaj bhi mujhe yaad hai।

Usne kaanpte hue kaha, "Please... meri family ki car ka accident ho gaya hai... woh log andar fase hue hain... ambulance aur police ko call kar dijiye..."

Maine turant phone nikaal kar ambulance aur police ko call kar diya।

Call khatam hote hi maine dobara us aurat ki taraf dekha...

Lekin woh wahan nahi thi।

Na sadak par... na aas-paas... na hi kisi ped ke peeche।

Jaise woh kabhi thi hi nahi।

Meri dost ne bhi dar kar kaha, "Abhi to yahin khadi thi... itni jaldi gayi kahan?"

Kuch hi der mein ambulance aur police ki gaadiyan wahan pahunch gayin। Humein laga shayad woh aurat apni family ke paas chali gayi hogi।

Hum ghar laut aaye।

Lekin us raat mujhe neend nahi aayi।

Har baar aankhen band karti, mujhe wahi bheega hua chehra nazar aata।

Agle din maine us area ke baare mein pata kiya।

Jo sach mere saamne aaya, usne meri rooh tak hila di।

Us raat sach mein us jagah ek bhayanak accident hua tha।

Meri call ki wajah se ambulance waqt par pahunch gayi thi aur car mein fase hue logon ki jaan bach gayi thi।

Lekin...

Us family ki ek mahila ki maut accident ke kuch hi pal baad ho gayi thi।

Main us family ke baare mein aur jaankari lena chahti thi। Main jaana chahti thi ki kya woh wahi aurat thi jise maine dekha tha।

Par mujhe kabhi kuch pata nahi chal saka।

Naam nahi...

Pehchaan nahi...

Kuch bhi nahi।

Bas itna pata chala ki agar ambulance thodi aur der se aati, to shayad poora parivaar nahi bach pata।

Aaj bhi jab tez baarish hoti hai, aandhi chalti hai aur main kisi sunsaan sadak se guzarti hoon...

Mujhe woh bheega hua chehra yaad aata hai।

Aur dil mein ek ajeeb sa ehsaas hota hai...

Jaise ek maa, ek patni, ya ek aurat apni aakhri saans ke baad bhi sirf apne parivaar ko bachana chahti thi।

Aur phir mere dimaag mein wahi sawaal ghoomta rehta hai—

**Aakhir woh aurat kaun thi... aur agar woh usi accident mein mar chuki thi, to meri car ki window par khatkhataane kaun aaya tha?** 🌧️👣

title: Har Kisi Ko Aise Rishte Nahi Milte
content:
Kuch rishte khoon ke nahi hote, phir bhi dil ke itne kareeb hote hain ki unki jagah koi aur kabhi nahi le sakta। Pata nahi Bhagwaan kaun si dor se aise logon ko hamari zindagi se jod dete hain, lekin jab bhi zindagi andheron se bhar jaati hai, wahi log roshni bankar saath khade nazar aate hain।

Meri zindagi mein bhi do aise rishte hain — ek meri aunty aur ek meri dost। Shayad in dono ko meri zindagi mein bhejna Bhagwaan ka sabse sundar aashirwad tha।

Pichhle kuch saalon mein meri zindagi mein bahut kuch hua। Aise pal bhi aaye jab laga ki ab sab kuch khatam ho gaya hai। Dil itna toot chuka tha ki khud ko sambhalne ki himmat nahi bachi thi। Kai baar laga ki meri baaton ko samajhne wala koi nahi, meri takleef dekhne wala koi nahi। Bahar se muskurati thi, lekin andar se bilkul khaali ho chuki thi।

Lekin har baar, jab main haar maan ne lagti thi, tab ye dono mere saath khade milte the। Kabhi ek phone call, kabhi ek message, kabhi sirf itna keh dena — "Main hoon na" — aur pata nahi kaise meri aankhon ke aansu ruk jaate the।

Inhone kabhi mere dard ko chhota nahi kaha, kabhi mujhe judge nahi kiya, kabhi meri kamzori ka mazaak nahi banaya। Bas har baar meri baat suni, mujhe samjha aur mujhe yaad dilaya ki main important hoon, meri feelings important hain aur meri zindagi ki bhi keemat hai।

Jab mujhe lagta tha ki duniya mein kisi ko mere hone ya na hone se fark nahi padta, tab in dono ne apne pyaar aur apnapan se mujhe mehsoos karaya ki koi hai jo meri fikr karta hai, koi hai jo meri khushi mein khush aur mere dard mein dukhi hota hai।

Aaj main dil se maanta hoon ki har rishte ka naam zaroori nahi hota। Kuch log bas duaon ki tarah zindagi mein aate hain। Aur jab poori duniya aapko akela chhod deti hai, tab wahi log aapko tootne se bacha lete hain।

Bhagwaan har kisi ki zindagi mein aise do log zaroor bheje, jo mushkil waqt mein uska haath pakad kar bas itna keh dein — "Tum akeli nahi ho..." ❤️

title: Salary Se Zyada Keemti Thi Unki Muskaan
content:
Aaj meri pehli salary account mein aayi. Shayad meri zindagi ke un khaas palon mein se ek, jise main shabdon mein poori tarah bayan nahi kar sakti. Jab mobile par salary credit ka message dekha, to pehli baar mehsoos hua ki education aur mehnat ki asli keemat kya hoti hai. Samajh aaya ki paise kamana kitna mushkil hai aur isi liye unki importance kitni zyada hoti hai.

Salary aate hi maine socha ki online transfer ya card se kaam nahi chalega. Mujhe apni pehli salary ko haath mein mehsoos karna tha. Isliye main seedha bank pahunch gayi. Government bank tha, lambi line thi, bahut saari formalities thi aur waiting time bhi kaafi zyada tha. Lekin us din na mujhe garmi ki parwah thi, na intezar ki. Dil mein bas ek hi khushi thi ki aaj meri mehnat ka pehla phal milne wala hai.

Jab paise haath mein aaye, to unhe dekhkar ek alag hi ehsaas hua. Ghar pahunchte hi maine woh saare paise mummy-papa ke haath mein rakh diye aur kaha, "Yeh aapke paise hain, aap jaisa chahein inhe use kariye."

Us pal mummy-papa ke chehre par jo garv aur khushi thi, use dekhkar meri aankhen bhar aayi. Mujhe laga jaise meri salary ki asli keemat un noton mein nahi, balki unki muskurahat mein thi. Pehli baar mehsoos hua ki kamane ki khushi sirf apne liye nahi hoti, balki un logon ke liye bhi hoti hai jinhone humein is mukaam tak pahunchane ke liye apni poori zindagi laga di.

Aaj bhi meri pehli salary ki yaad aati hai, to paise yaad nahi aate... mummy-papa ki aankhon mein dikhta woh garv yaad aata hai। ❤️

title: Meri Pehli Salary Ka Gulab
content:
Naina ek middle-class family ki ladki thi. Bachpan se usne apni maa ko har chhoti-badi zarurat ke liye paise jodte dekha tha. Jab bhi use kuch kharidna hota, woh sochti, "Ek din main apne paise se sab kuch karungi."

College khatam hote hi Naina ko ek achhi job mil gayi. Pehli salary aane wali thi aur woh bahut excited thi. Usne socha tha ki apne liye ek sundar dress kharidegi, ek achha handbag legi aur doston ke saath party karegi.

Salary wale din usne mobile khola aur account mein paise dekhkar uski aankhen chamak uthi. Lekin office se ghar aate waqt uski nazar ek phoolon ki dukaan par padi. Usne ek chhota sa gulab kharida aur seedha ghar pahunch gayi.

Ghar aakar usne woh gulab apni maa ko diya aur bola, "Maa, yeh meri pehli salary ka pehla kharcha hai."

Maa muskura di, lekin agle hi pal unki aankhen bhar aayi. Unhone pucha, "Bas ek gulab?"

Naina hansi aur maa ka haath pakadkar boli, "Nahi Maa, baaki salary se maine aapke liye woh chashma order kiya hai jise aap mahino se taal rahi thi. Aur Papa ke liye woh watch bhi jo unhe pasand thi."

Maa ne use gale laga liya.

Us raat Naina ne samjha ki financial independence ka matlab sirf apne sapne poore karna nahi hota। Kabhi-kabhi iska sabse khoobsurat ehsaas yeh hota hai ki ab aap apne parents ki chhoti-chhoti khwahishen bhi poori kar sakte hain।

Aur us din woh chhota sa gulab Naina ko kisi bhi mehngi shopping se zyada keemti laga। 🌹❤️

mera mana hai ki Financial independence sirf paise kamane ka naam nahi, balki apno ke chehre par muskaan lane ki taqat ka naam hai। ✨

title: Kitchen Ki Summer Vacations
content:
Aaj kal bachchon ki holidays chal rahi hain aur meri kitchen ki duty double ho gayi hai. 😄 Subah aankh khulte hi pehla sawal hota hai, "Mummy, aaj kya yummy banega?" Aur yummy ka matlab aksar pizza, burger, fries ya noodles hi hota hai. Ab roz-roz junk food dene ka mann bhi nahi karta aur mana karo to bachchon ke chehre utar jaate hain.

Main bhi har din yahi sochti hoon ki kuch aisa banaun jo unhe tasty bhi lage aur healthy bhi ho. Kabhi vegetable sandwich ko funny shape de deti hoon, kabhi atta pizza bana leti hoon, to kabhi fruit custard ya homemade popsicles. Sach kahun to khana banane se zyada dimaag yeh sochne mein lagta hai ki aaj naya kya banaun. 😅

Phir kabhi-kabhi main khud ko samjhati hoon ki ye din bhi jaldi nikal jayenge. Kuch hi dino mein school shuru ho jayenge, homework, projects aur classes mein bachche busy ho jayenge. Phir na unki itni demands hongi aur na hi din bhar "Mummy bhookh lagi hai" ki awaaz sunai degi.

Isliye ab sochti hoon ki thodi si thakan aur thodi si extra mehnat sahi, par ye holidays aur bachchon ki choti-choti farmaishen hi to kal ki pyari yaadein banengi. ❤️

title: shadi ya divorce?
content:
Meri choti behan ki shaadi ko abhi sirf do mahine hi hue the aur aaj baat divorce tak pahunch gayi hai। Jab bhi usse dekhti hoon, dil bhar aata hai। Woh jo shaadi ke din kitne sapne lekar gayi thi, aaj wahi ladki itni toot chuki hai ki sasural wapas jaane ka naam tak nahi lena chahti। Uska kehna hai, "Didi, wahan mera dam ghutta hai। Main khud ko kho rahi hoon। Main wapas nahi jaungi।"

Main uski baat sunti hoon, uske aansu dekhti hoon, par sach kahun to kai baar samajh nahi aata ki use kaise samjhaun। Hamare desh mein kitni hi ladkiyan shaadi ke baad naye ghar, naye logon aur naye niyamon ke saath adjust karti hain। Har bahu ko kuch na kuch sehna padta hai, kuch apni aadatein badalती hain, kuch apne sapne thode waqt ke liye side par rakh deti hain। Shaadi kabhi bhi fairy tale nahi hoti, jahan sab kuch perfect ho। Har rishte mein adjustment, compromise aur samay lagta hai।

Lekin phir jab main apni behan ki aankhon mein woh dar, woh ghutan aur woh tutna dekhti hoon, to mera dil bhi ulajh jata hai। Kya har takleef ko adjustment ka naam de dena chahiye? Kya sirf isliye ki bahut si auratein seh leti hain, meri behan bhi seh le? Ya phir kisi insaan ki mental peace aur self-respect bhi utni hi zaroori hai jitni shaadi ko bachana?

Kabhi lagta hai ki toxic rishte mein poori zindagi ghut-ghut kar jeene se behtar hai ki insaan apni sharton par jiye, chahe mayke mein rahe ya apne dam par nayi zindagi shuru kare। Aur kabhi lagta hai ki shayad do mahine bahut chhota waqt hai, shayad thoda aur samay dena chahiye tha। Bas isi uljhan mein hoon।

Ek taraf meri behan ka dard hai, doosri taraf samaj ki soch, rishton ki ahmiyat aur shaadi ko bachane ki baat। Shayad har kahani ka jawab ek jaisa nahi hota। Bas itna chahti hoon ki meri behan jo bhi faisla le, woh dar ya majboori se nahi, balki apni khushi, apni izzat aur apni mental peace ko samajh kar le। Kyunki shaadi zaroor important hai, par kisi ki zindagi aur uska sukoon usse bhi zyada important hai।

title: Maids on protest
content:
**Hello Ladies,**

Aajkal hamari society mein maids ne protest kar rakha hai. Sab milkar meetings kar rahi hain, ek saath rate decide kar rahi hain aur poori unity ke saath apni baat rakh rahi hain. Unka kehna hai ki har cheez mehngi ho gayi hai, isliye unki salary bhi badhni chahiye.

Sach kahun to unki baat bhi galat nahi lagti. Aaj grocery se lekar electricity bill tak, har cheez ke daam badh gaye hain. Unhe bhi apna ghar chalana hota hai.

Lekin phir mann mein ek aur sawal aata hai...

Hum middle-class log kahan jaayein?

Hamare liye bhi to mehngai utni hi badhi hai. Doodh, sabzi, school fees, medical expenses, electricity bill, petrol... har mahine kharch badhte ja rahe hain, lekin salary us hisaab se nahi badh rahi.

Ek taraf maids salary badhane ki baat kar rahi hain, doosri taraf hum apna monthly budget sambhalne ki koshish kar rahe hain. Kabhi-kabhi lagta hai ki sabse zyada pressure middle class par hi hai. Na hum kisi scheme ke liye eligible hote hain aur na hi itni income hoti hai ki bina soche-samjhe kharch kar saken.

Aajkal ghar ka budget manage karna bhi kisi management course se kam nahi lagta. 😅

Aapke area mein bhi aisa kuch ho raha hai? Aur aap log badhti mehngai ko kaise manage kar rahe hain?

title: 25 Saal Ka Safar... Aur Aaj Main Hi Galat Ho Gayi? (Part 2)
content:
Us din jab maine apne baare mein woh baatein suni, to aisa laga jaise kisi ne mere 25 saal ke tyag aur pyaar par ek pal mein mitti daal di ho.

Main poori raat so nahi paayi.

Bar-bar wahi sawal mann mein aa raha tha...

"Kya sach mein meri itni hi pehchaan reh gayi hai?"

Jin nanadon ko maine apni behnon ki tarah pyaar diya, jin ke liye apni khushiyan tak kurbaan kar di... jin dever ki padhai ke liye maine apne gehne girvi rakhe... aaj unki nazron mein main woh aurat thi jisne parivaar tod diya tha.

Sabse zyada takleef is baat ki thi ki kisi ne mujhse sach jaanne ki koshish bhi nahi ki.

Kai mahino tak maine khud ko sabse door kar liya. Na kisi se shikayat ki, na kisi se safai di.

Phir ek din meri beti mere paas aayi aur boli,

"Mummy, aap itni udaas kyun rehti ho? Humne to hamesha aapko sabke liye jeete dekha hai. Ab thoda apne liye bhi jee lo."

Uski baat mere dil ko chhoo gayi.

Us din maine pehli baar socha ki shayad main apni poori zindagi dusron ki nazron mein achhi banne ki koshish karti rahi, lekin khud ki nazron mein khush rehna bhool gayi.

Samay beetta gaya...

Dheere-dheere sach bhi saamne aane laga.

Jab saas ji beemar hui aur unki dekhbhal ki zimmedari kisi aur par aayi, tab logon ko ehsaas hua ki jo kaam main saalon se chupchaap karti rahi, woh itna aasaan nahi tha.

Jab parivaar ke kuch log mushkilon se guzre, tab unhe samajh aaya ki rishton ko nibhana aur balidaan dena sirf baaton se nahi hota.

Ek din meri badi nanad ka phone aaya.

Woh ro rahi thi.

Usne sirf itna kaha,

"Bhabhi, shayad humne aapko kabhi samjha hi nahi. Aapne jo kiya, uski kadar hume bahut der se samajh aayi."

Us din meri aankhon mein bhi aansu aa gaye.

Mujhe kisi maafi ya safai ki zaroorat nahi thi.

Bas itna kaafi tha ki meri niyat ko samjha gaya.

Aaj 25 saal baad main yeh samajh chuki hoon ki zindagi mein har kisi ko khush rakhna mumkin nahi hai.

Jo log aapse sach mein pyaar karte hain, woh der se hi sahi, lekin aapki ahmiyat zaroor samajh jaate hain.

Aaj mere bachche apni zindagi mein khush hain. Mere pati mere har faisle mein mere saath khade hain. Aur sabse badi baat...

Aaj main khud se naraaz nahi hoon.

Maine apni zindagi ke 25 saal kisi hisaab-kitab ke liye nahi, balki apne dil se jeeye the.

Aur jab raat ko aaine mein khud ko dekhti hoon, to ek hi baat kehti hoon—

**"Maine galtiyan zaroor ki hongi, lekin maine kabhi kisi ka bura nahi chaha."**

Aur shayad... ek sukoon bhari zindagi jeene ke liye itna hi kaafi hai. ❤️✨

title: # 25 Saal Ka Safar... Aur Aaj Main Hi Galat Ho Gayi? (Part 1)
content:
Meri shaadi sirf 19 saal ki umar mein ho gayi thi. Na duniya ki zyada samajh thi aur na hi zindagi ke asli imtihaan dekhe the. Sapne bahut the, lekin shaadi ke baad un sapnon ki jagah zimmedariyon ne le li.

Mera sasural ek joint family tha. Ghar mein saas, nanadein aur dever the. Sasur ji ka dehant pehle hi ho chuka tha, isliye ghar ki har umeed mere pati aur mujhse judi hui thi.

Mere pati shehar se door naukri karte the aur ghar ki poori zimmedari mere kandhon par thi. Nanadon ki padhai, unki shaadi ki chinta, dever ki padhai, saas ji ki dekhbhal... dheere-dheere mujhe lagne laga tha ki main bahu kam aur ghar ki zimmedariyon ka doosra naam zyada hoon.

Maine kabhi kisi ka hisaab nahi rakha. Jo ban pada, karti gayi. Apne gehne tak girvi rakhe, taaki dever ki fees bhar sake. Nanadon ki shaadi mein apni pasand aur zaruratein tak peeche chhod di. Mujhe lagta tha ki yahi parivaar hota hai... yahi apnapan hota hai.

Samay beetta gaya. Mere do bachche hue. Maa-papa ka sahara na hota to shayad main toot jaati. Unhone mujhe har mushkil waqt mein sambhala, jabki main khud apne sasural ko sambhalne mein lagi hui thi.

Kuch saalon baad maine himmat karke apni awaaz uthayi aur pati ke saath us shehar mein shift ho gayi jahan unki job thi. Pehli baar laga ki ab shayad apni zindagi bhi jee paungi.

Lekin kahani yahin khatam nahi hui...

Jin logon ke liye maine apni jawani, apne sapne aur apni khushiyan daav par laga di thi, wahi log dheere-dheere badalne lage.

Mere saamne pyaar aur apnapan tha, lekin peeth peeche kuch aur hi kahani chal rahi thi...

Mujhe tab tak kuch pata nahi tha, jab tak ek din galti se mere kaano mein woh baat nahi padi jo meri poori duniya hila dene wali thi.

Pata chala ki kuch rishtedaron ke beech meri hi kahani alag tarah se sunayi ja rahi thi. Kaha ja raha tha ki maine sabko alag kar diya... maine ghar tod diya... maine pati ko parivaar se door kar diya.

Aur sabse zyada dard tab hua jab yeh baatein un logon ki zubaan se nikli, jinke liye maine apni zindagi ke 25 saal de diye the.

Us din pehli baar samajh aaya...

Kabhi-kabhi log aapke tyag ko yaad nahi rakhte, sirf apni zarurat yaad rakhte hain.

Aur aaj... 25 saal baad...



**(To Be Continued... Part 2)**

title: Do Morchon Ki Jung
content:
Mein ek working woman thi. Shaadi ke baad woh ek joint family ka hissa bani. Uske do pyare bachche the aur ek private company mein achhi job bhi karti thi. Bahar se dekhne par uski zindagi perfect lagti thi, lekin asal mein woh har din do alag-alag morchon par lad rahi thi – office politics aur house politics.

Subah 5 baje uska din shuru ho jaata. Sabse pehle bachchon ka tiffin, school ki taiyari, ghar ke kaam aur phir office ke liye bhaagna. Jab tak woh office pahunchti, uska aadha din jaise khatam ho chuka hota.

Office mein uski mehnat sab dekhte the, lekin kuch log uski safalta se khush nahi the. Ek colleague, Neha, hamesha uske ideas ko apna bata kar boss ke saamne pesh kar deti thi. Kabhi uske kaam mein galtiyan dhoondhi jaati, to kabhi use important meetings ki jaankari hi nahi di jaati.

mujh ko bura lagta tha, lekin usne kabhi shikayat karne ke bajay apne kaam ko aur behtar banana chuna. Woh jaanti thi ki sachchi pehchaan mehnat se banti hai, doosron ko neecha dikhane se nahi.

Lekin office ki pareshaniyan khatam nahi hoti thi ki ghar ki chunautiyan uska intezar kar rahi hoti thi.

Joint family mein kuch logon ko lagta tha ki working woman ghar ko poora samay nahi de sakti. Agar bachcha beemar ho jaata, to kaha jaata, "Job karti ho, isliye bachchon par dhyaan nahi hai." Aur agar office se chhutti lekar bachchon ke saath rehti, to office mein sunna padta, "Aap career ko seriously nahi leti."

mujh ko lagta tha jaise woh har kisi ki ummeedon par khara utarne ki koshish kar rahi ho, lekin phir bhi kisi ko poori tarah khush nahi kar pa rahi.

Ek din office mein uske project ko national level par award mila. Boss ne sabke saamne uski tarif ki. Ghar aakar usne socha ki aaj sab uski khushi mein khush honge.

Lekin ghar mein kisi ko us award se zyada matlab nahi tha. Sab apni baaton mein vyast the. Us raat Swati bahut royi.

Phir usne ek baat samjhi...

Har jeet par taaliyan bajane wale log mil jaayen, yeh zaroori nahi. Kabhi-kabhi apni peeth khud thapthapani padti hai.

Usne apni safalta ko doosron ki swikriti se jodna chhod diya. Dheere-dheere usne office ki politics ko professionalism se aur ghar ki politics ko shanti aur samajhdari se handle karna seekh liya.

Saalon baad jab uske bachche bade hue, unhone apni maa ki sangharsh bhari zindagi ko samjha. Ek din uski beti ne kaha,

"Mummy, maine aapko kabhi haar maante nahi dekha. Aap meri sabse badi inspiration ho."

Yeh sunkar Swati ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye.

Usne mehsoos kiya ki uski asli jeet promotion ya award nahi thi. Uski asli jeet thi apne bachchon ke liye ek misaal banna aur har mushkil ke baad bhi apni pehchaan ko zinda rakhna.

Seekh:
Ek working woman aksar do jagah ki zimmedariyan nibhati hai. Log uske sangharsh ko hamesha nahi dekh paate, lekin uski himmat aur mehnat hi uski sabse badi taqat hoti hai. Kabhi-kabhi sabse badi jeet sirf itna hota hai ki aap har mushkil ke baad bhi khade rahte hain. 💜

title: # My First Day at Engineering College 🎓✨
content:
My name is Anika, and today was my first day at engineering college. To be honest, I was excited and nervous at the same time.

The night before, I could hardly sleep. So many thoughts were running through my mind. How would my classmates be? Would I make new friends? What if I couldn't fit in?

In the morning, I got ready much earlier than usual. My parents were even more excited than I was. Before leaving, my mother gave me a hug and said, "Just be yourself." Those words stayed with me throughout the day.

As I entered the college campus, I was amazed by the huge buildings, laboratories, and the crowd of students. Everything looked so different from school. For a few minutes, I felt completely lost.

Then I met a few girls who were also looking for their classroom. We started talking and soon realized that all of us were feeling the same nervousness. That conversation made me feel much more comfortable.

The orientation session was interesting. The professors spoke about innovation, technology, and the opportunities waiting for us. Listening to them made me realize that I was finally beginning a new chapter of my life.

Of course, there were some funny moments too. I got confused between different blocks, almost entered the wrong classroom, and spent ten minutes searching for the canteen!

By the end of the day, my fear had slowly turned into excitement. I had made a few new friends, explored a small part of the campus, and felt a little more confident.

When I came home, my parents eagerly asked, "How was your first day?"

With a smile on my face, I replied, "It was scary, exciting, confusing, and wonderful—all at the same time."

And that is how my engineering journey began. A journey filled with dreams, challenges, friendships, and countless memories waiting to be created. ❤️

title: Spiritual Trips Are Good for Mental Health 🙏✨
content:
Is baar mujhe apni family ke saath **Khatu Shyam Ji** aur **Salasar Balaji** ke darshan karne ka mauka mila। Sach kahun to yeh sirf ek trip nahi, balki ek bahut hi sukoon bhara aur positive experience tha।

Jaise hi mandir ke prangan mein kadam rakha, mann ko ek alag hi shanti ka ehsaas hua। Darshan ke liye bheed thi, lekin bhakton ki shraddha aur bhakti dekhkar dil khush ho gaya। "Hare Ka Sahara, Baba Shyam Hamara" ke jaikaron ne poore mahaul ko bhakti se bhar diya tha।

Salasar Balaji mein bhi darshan karke bahut accha laga। Wahan ki energy aur positivity ne mann ko halka aur prasann kar diya। Kuch der ke liye aisa laga jaise zindagi ki saari chintayein peeche chhoot gayi hon।

Sabse acchi baat yeh thi ki yeh ek family trip thi। Hum sabne saath mein travel kiya, darshan kiye, local food enjoy kiya aur bahut saari yaadein banayi। Aajkal ki busy life mein aise pal bahut kam milte hain jab poori family bina kisi tension ke ek saath waqt bita sake।

Ghar lautne ke baad bhi us yatra ki positivity aur sukoon ab tak mere saath hai। Kabhi-kabhi aise dharmik safar sirf darshan hi nahi karvate, balki humein andar se bhi mazboot aur shaant bana dete hain। 🙏❤️

**Jai Shri Shyam 🙏 Jai Salasar Balaji 🙏**

title: Dental clinic experience
content:
**Aaj mera RCT (Root Canal Treatment) ka session tha... 🦷😅**

Sach kahun to dentist ke clinic jaate hi meri aadhi himmat to waiting area mein hi chhoot gayi thi. Dental chair par baithte hi dimaag mein hazaar khayal aa rahe the – kitna pain hoga, kitna time lagega aur kab khatam hoga!

RCT ka process waise to zaroori tha, lekin patience ki bhi poori pariksha le gaya. Kaafi der tak chair par baithe rehna, munh khula rakhna aur treatment ke har step se guzarna aasan nahi tha. Kuch pal aise bhi aaye jab laga ki bas ab aur nahi.

Lekin phir socha, kabhi-kabhi thodi der ki takleef humein lambe samay ke dard se chutkara dilati hai.

Clinic ka staff aur doctor bahut supportive the. Har step samjhate rahe aur koshish karte rahe ki main comfortable rahun. Dheere-dheere darr kam hua aur relief zyada mehsoos hone laga.

Jab treatment ke baad clinic se bahar nikli, to thodi thakan thi, lekin usse kahin zyada sukoon tha. Ek aur baat samajh aayi — health ka khayal rakhna hamesha comfortable nahi hota, lekin zaroori zaroor hota hai.

Abhi bhi muh thoda heavy lag raha hai, lekin dil khush hai ki ek bada step complete ho gaya. 😊

**Kya aapka bhi kabhi RCT ya dental treatment ka yaadgaar experience raha hai?** 💙

title: Support from like minded people ...
content:
**Mental Health ke liye sabse zaroori kya hai?**

Mujhe lagta hai, mental health ka sabse bada support koi therapy technique ya motivational quote nahi, balki **aise log hote hain jo aapko samajhte hain.**

Har din ka thoda sa waqt un logon ke saath bitaiye jinke saamne aap bina kisi dar ke apni baat rakh sakte hain. Jahan aapko apne emotions explain karne ke liye baar-baar saboot na dene padhein. Jahan aapki baat suni bhi jaye aur samjhi bhi jaye.

Kabhi-kabhi problem utni badi nahi hoti jitni badi woh hamare mann ke andar ban jaati hai. Hum use baar-baar sochte hain, usmein uljhte rehte hain aur dheere-dheere woh hamari shanti cheen leti hai.

Lekin jab wahi baat kisi apne se share karte hain, to uska bojh aadha ho jaata hai.

Har insaan ko life mein kam se kam ek aisa dost, ek aisa rishta, ya ek aisa community space zaroor milna chahiye jahan woh khulkar keh sake—

*"Aaj main theek nahi hoon."*

Aur saamne se sirf itna jawab mile—

*"Koi baat nahi, main sun raha/rahi hoon."*

Shayad agar zyada logon ko aisa saath mil jaye, to bahut se log apne dukhon ke saath itne akela mehsoos na karein.

Zindagi bahut keemti hai.

Ise har chhoti-badi baat ko dil mein daba kar, har fikr ko akele utha kar mat guzariye.

Kabhi-kabhi bas baat kar lena bhi healing ka pehla kadam hota hai. ❤️

title: LifeThoughts
content:
**Aajkal ek baat bahut mehsoos hoti hai...**

Kaun sach bol raha hai aur kaun jhooth, ye samajhna pehle se zyada mushkil ho gaya hai. Har taraf itni awaazein hain, itni rai hai, itni kahaniyan hain ki kabhi-kabhi sach bhi shor mein kahin kho sa jata hai.

Shayad isi liye ab andha bharosa karna mushkil lagta hai. Aur kai baar dhokhe ya nirasha ke baad dil ye bhi kehta hai ki kisi par bharosa hi na kiya jaye.

Lekin maine ek baat seekhi hai — jab bahar ki duniya uljhanon se bhari lage, tab apne andar ki awaaz ko sunna aur bhi zaroori ho jata hai. Har baat ko turant sach maan lena bhi theek nahi, aur har kisi par shak karte rehna bhi sukoon nahi deta.

Aajkal main logon ko unke shabdon se zyada unke vyavhaar se samajhne ki koshish karti hoon. Kyunki sach aksar bolne se zyada dikhai deta hai.

Duniya chahe kitni bhi badal jaye, ek cheez hamesha hamare haath mein rehti hai — khud sachcha rehna, khud imaandaar rehna, aur apne dil ki safai ko bachaye rakhna.

**Aap kya sochti hain? Aaj ke daur mein bharosa karna zyada mushkil ho gaya hai ya hum zyada satark ho gaye hain?** 💭✨

#WomenKonnect #LifeThoughts #Trust #Relationships #SelfAwareness #PositiveLiving #HinglishPost #CommunityTalks

title: Title: "Bas 4 Din Ki Zindagi...
content:
Jab meri shaadi hui thi, tab ghar ke bade aksar ek baat kaha karte the, "Beta, zindagi bahut chhoti hai... bas 4 din ki hai. Rishton ko nibhana seekho."

Maine unki baat dil se maan li. Har baar jab meri koi khwahish adhuri reh jaati, main soch leti — chalo, 4 din ki hi to zindagi hai. Jab job chhodni padi, tab bhi yahi suna. Jab har faisle mein meri pasand se pehle ghar walon ki pasand rakhi gayi, tab bhi yahi suna.

Saal beet gaye. Main sabki khushi ka khayal rakhti rahi. Bachchon ki parvarish, ghar ki zimmedariyan, rishtedaron ki seva... sab kuch karti rahi. Har baar apne dil ko samjha leti thi ki bade log zyada samajhdar hote hain.

Ek din meri beti ne mujhse poocha, "Mumma, aapko kya pasand hai?"

Main kuch der chup rahi. Mujhe sach mein jawab yaad nahi tha.

Us din ehsaas hua ki dusron ki zindagi aasaan banate-banate maine apni pehchaan hi kahin kho di thi. Jo log hamesha kehte the "4 din ki zindagi hai", unke liye shayad sach mein 4 din the. Lekin un 4 dino ko nibhaate-nibhaate meri poori zindagi nikal gayi.

Aaj bhi main ghar ke badon ki izzat karti hoon. Unke anubhav ki kadar karti hoon. Lekin maine ek baat seekh li hai — rishton ko nibhana zaroori hai, par khud ko khona nahi।

Kyuki zindagi sirf dusron ke liye jeene ka naam nahi hai. Thoda sa jeena khud ke liye bhi zaroori hota hai.

title: My mann ki shanti....
content:
Hello Ladies....

Aap sabse mujhe apne mann ki baat share karni hai. mujhe kabhi kabhi lagta tha ki logon ki baatein mujhe andar tak hila deti hain.
Kisi ka rude behaviour, kisi ki misunderstanding, kisi ka bina wajah judge kar dena…
har cheez mann mei reh jaati thi.

Par dheere dheere samajh aaya ki agar har insaan ke hisaab se khudko badalne lagungi,
to ek din khudko hi kho dungi.

Ab mai alag alag logon se milkar bhi khudko santulit rakhna seekh rahi hoon ✨

Har kisi ki baat dil par lena zaroori nahi hota.
Har reaction ka jawab dena bhi zaroori nahi hota.

Kuch log sirf apna dard dusron par nikalte hain,
aur kuch log kabhi khudki galti dekhna hi nahi chahte.
Pehle mai unhe samjhane mei lag jaati thi…
ab mai khudko samajhne mei waqt lagati hoon 🌸

Ab agar mann disturb ho,
to thodi der khamosh reh leti hoon,
music sun leti hoon,
khudse baat kar leti hoon.

Kyuki maine seekha hai —
har jagah khudko prove karne se zyada zaroori hai
apne andar ki shanti bachake rakhna 💫

Aap sab kaise isko experience karti hain aur kaise handle karti hain jarur bataiye. ho sakta hai mujhe kuch aur naya sikhne ko mile.

title: Holidays Homework
content:
Hi Ladies,
Today I seriously want to vent about this kids’ holiday homework. 😅
Ye homework hai ya full-time project?

Sach bolo… half of these tasks bachche karte hi nahi hain. Mostly mothers hi baith kar charts banati hain, models decorate karti hain, printouts nikalti hain aur “beta complete karo” bolte-bolte khud ka patience complete ho jata hai. 😭

Puri vacations isi tension mein nikal jaati hain —
“Pad lo… homework complete karo… project finish karo…”
Aur bachche?
Unhe bas holidays enjoy karni hoti hain. 😄

Vacations ka matlab family time, rest aur fun hona chahiye…
par yahan to moms ki extra duty lag jaati hai. 😂

Respect to all of us mothers for silently completing school projects behind the scenes. 🫡💖

title: No Emotional Support..
content:
Burai hume kab aur kaise gher leti hai,
ye hum khud bhi samajh nahi paate...

Maine bahut koshish ki achha banne ki,
sabke mann ki karne ki,
har rishte ko jodkar rakhne ki.

Par dheere-dheere hua ye
ki sabne mujh mein hi kamiyan dhoondhni shuru kar di.
Aur aakhir mei mujhe hi akela chhod diya...

Mera dard, mere aansu,
meri baaton ka kisi par koi asar hi nahi hua.
Sabne apni taraf se faisle suna diye,
par apni galti kabhi kisi ne nahi maani...

Shayad galti meri sirf itni thi
ki maine dusron ko samajhne mei
khud ko hi nazarandaaz kar diya.

shayad isliye baki sabne bhi mujhe 
nazarandaaz kar diya.

title: घिया, तोरई, टिंडा…
content:
बचपन में जिन सब्ज़ियों से भागते थे,
बड़े होकर वही अपने हाथों से बनाते हैं…
और फिर समझ आता है कि
मम्मी सिर्फ सब्ज़ी नहीं बना रही थीं,
वो हमारी सेहत, आदतें और भविष्य पकाती थीं।

घिया, तोरई, टिंडा…
नाम सुनते ही मेरा मुंह बन जाता था।
मम्मी लाख समझातीं,
पापा प्यार से मनाते,
पर मैं उनकी लाडली बेटी,
ज़िद पर अड़ी रहती थी।

तब लगता था —
“इतनी सारी अच्छी चीज़ें हैं दुनिया में,
ये फीकी सब्ज़ियाँ ही क्यों?”

और आज…
खुद रसोई में खड़ी होकर
वही सब्ज़ियाँ बनाती हूँ।
धीरे-धीरे मसाले डालते हुए
अचानक मम्मी याद आ जाती हैं।

फिर अपने बच्चों को बुलाती हूँ —
“बस थोड़ा सा खा लो…”

और सामने से वही चेहरे,
वही नखरे,
वही बहाने…

तब हँसी भी आती है
और मम्मी की मेहनत समझ भी आती है।

ज़िंदगी सच में गोल चक्कर है…
हम बड़े होकर
धीरे-धीरे अपने माता-पिता जैसे ही हो जाते हैं।

title: Maa Ka Dil Aur Bete Ki Udaan
content:
Aaj ghar mein suitcases khule pade the…
Kapde fold ho rahe the, books arrange ho rahi thi, naye shoes, naye sapne… sab kuch naya tha.
Bas ek cheez purani thi — ek maa ka darr.

Nimisha baar-baar bete ke bag mein kuch na kuch rakh deti…
“Ye medicine rakh le…”
“Ye ghar ka bana achar bhi…”
“Raat ko zyada der tak mat jagna…”

Beta hansi mein bolta —
“Mumma… main ab bachcha nahi hoon.”

Par maa ke liye bachche kab bade hote hain…

Raat ko sab so gaye, lekin Nimisha ki aankhon mein neend nahi thi.
Woh chupchaap bete ke room mein gayi.
Room ki walls par abhi bhi uske bachpan ki photos lagi thi.
Ek photo mein woh school uniform mein ro raha tha kyunki uska school ka pehla din tha.

Aaj phir wahi darr tha…
Bas farq itna tha ki tab school ghar se 10 minute door tha, aur aaj Bengaluru hazaaron kilometer door.

Nimisha bed par baith gayi.
Usne takiye ko haath lagaya…
Aur achanak uski aankhon se aansu behne lage.

“Kaise rahega akela…?”
“Bimaar hua toh kaun dekhega…?”
“Kahin galat doston ke saath na pad jaye…”
“Raat ko bhooka so gaya toh…?”

Ek maa ka dil hazaar darr soch leta hai.

Subah station par bahut bheed thi.
Beta baar-baar bol raha tha —
“Mumma please rona mat…”

Lekin jaise hi train chalne lagi, Nimisha khud ko rok nahi paayi.
Usne bete ka chehra dono haathon mein pakda aur bas itna kaha —

“Khud ka dhyaan rakhna…
Aur jab bhi lage ki tum akele ho, yaad rakhna… tumhari maa ki dua hamesha tumhare saath hai.”

Train dheere-dheere door chali gayi.
Nimisha platform par tab tak khadi rahi jab tak train aankhon se ojhal nahi ho gayi.

Ghar lautkar usne bete ka room khola.
Room waise hi tha…
Lekin ab wahan awaaz nahi thi.
Na “Mumma paani dena…”
Na “Mera charger kahan hai?”
Na der raat tak hasi.

Us din Nimisha ne pehli baar mehsoos kiya —
Bachche jab bade hote hain, toh sirf unka room khaali nahi hota…
Maa ka ek hissa bhi unke saath chala jaata hai.

Raat ko achanak video call aaya.
Screen ke us paar hostel ka chhota sa room tha…
Aur uska beta muskura raha tha.

“Mumma… maine khud se khana kha liya, room bhi set kar liya… aur haan, aapka achar sabse pehle khatam hoga.”

Nimisha hans padi… aansuon ke saath.

Us pal use samajh aaya —
Bachche ghar zaroor chhod dete hain…
Par maa ki parvarish kabhi unka saath nahi chhodti. ❤️

title: Responsibility and Dreams
content:
My name is Ojasvi, and honestly, joining this platform made me feel a little lighter. It feels good to have a place where we can share our feelings and problems without being judged.

I have been working in the same company for the last 10 years. In the beginning, everything felt rewarding. My hard work was noticed, promotions came on time, and I felt motivated to do better every year. But slowly, things started changing.

Now, no matter how much effort I put in, nobody seems to notice. This year hurt the most… I did not even get an increment. Watching others move ahead while I stayed in the same place broke something inside me.

Sometimes I feel office politics matters more than hard work.

The biggest reason I cannot leave this job is my family. My office is close to my home, and I also get work-from-home flexibility whenever needed. Because of this, I am able to manage both my job and my family responsibilities. Deep down, I feel my boss also understands that I cannot leave easily… and maybe that is why I am no longer treated fairly.

Every morning I wake up with the same confusion in my heart — should I continue adjusting silently for my family, or should I finally think about my own growth and self-respect?

I don’t know what the right decision is anymore. I just know that staying in a place where your efforts are ignored slowly makes you lose confidence in yourself.

Sometimes during office meetings, I sit quietly and wonder where the old confident Ojasvi disappeared.
Earlier, I used to share ideas fearlessly, but now I overthink even before speaking.
The saddest part is not the lack of promotion… it is the feeling of being invisible after giving so many years to one company.
There are days when I cry silently after logging out from work.
My family thinks work from home has made my life easier, but they do not see the mental pressure I carry every single day.
I smile in front of everyone because I do not want my children to feel my stress.
Many times, I open job portals at night and then quietly close them again out of fear and confusion.
Starting somewhere new after 10 years feels scary.
But somewhere deep inside, I still hope that one day I will find a workplace where experience, loyalty, and hard work are truly valued.
Until then, I am just trying to stay strong… one day at a time.

title: Meri  25 Saal Ki Khamoshi
content:
आज मेरी 25th anniversary है…
घर में celebration की तैयारी हो रही है। मेरे husband ने शायद पहली बार इतने मन से कुछ plan किया है, मुझे surprise देने के लिए। सब लोग कहेंगे कि मैं कितनी lucky हूँ… 25 साल का साथ, भरा-पूरा परिवार, बच्चे, घर… सब कुछ। पर जाने क्यों, आज दिल में खुशी नहीं है।

पहले मैं अपने बारे में बताती हूँ… मेरा नाम Nidhi है। मैं एक well-off family से आती हूँ, जहाँ कभी किसी चीज़ की कमी नहीं रही। ऐसा नहीं था कि मेरे papa कोई business tycoon थे, वो government job में थे, लेकिन उन्होंने हमें हमेशा एक comfortable और सम्मान वाली जिंदगी दी। मैं पढ़ाई में average थी, मगर कुछ करने की चाह हमेशा थी। मेरी mummy चाहती थीं कि मैं working woman बनूँ, अपनी पहचान बनाऊँ। शायद भगवान ने उनकी सुन भी ली थी… मेरी job एक IT company में लग गई। मुझे खुद भी यकीन नहीं हुआ था कि मेरी जिंदगी इतनी अच्छी दिशा में जाएगी।

लेकिन शादी के बाद सब बदल गया। ससुराल वालों को मेरा job करना पसंद नहीं था। कहा गया कि “घर की बहू 8 से 9 की नौकरी नहीं करेगी।” और बस… मेरी दुनिया वहीं रुक गई। शुरू के 4-5 साल मेरे लिए किसी जेल से कम नहीं थे। हमेशा साड़ी पहनकर रहो, सिर ढककर रहो, balcony में मत खड़ी हो, अपनी माँ से ज्यादा बात मत करो… और भी न जाने कितनी बातें। धीरे-धीरे मैंने अपनी हर इच्छा को दबाना सीख लिया।

दो miscarriages के बाद जब मैं तीसरी बार pregnant हुई और मेरा बेटा आने वाला था, तब doctor ने complete bed rest कहा था। लेकिन घर के काम रुकते नहीं थे। शुरू के तीन महीने तक मैं काम करती रही। फिर जब doctor ने सख्ती दिखाई, तब जाकर घर वाले माने। लेकिन सातवां महीना आते-आते saas ki tabiyat खराब हो गई और मैं फिर काम में लग गई। शायद महादेव की कृपा थी कि मेरा बेटा ठीक सलामत इस दुनिया में आया। लेकिन उस दौरान जो तकरार, जो ताने, जो अकेलापन मैंने महसूस किया… उसने मेरे अंदर बहुत कुछ तोड़ दिया।

फिर बेटी के समय… और माँ के जाने के बाद… मैं पूरी तरह टूट चुकी थी। कई बार मन हुआ कि सब छोड़कर माँ के पास चली जाऊँ। लेकिन बच्चों का चेहरा देखकर हिम्मत नहीं हुई। भगवान जैसे बार-बार मेरी परीक्षा लेते रहे… और हर बार मेरा दिल थोड़ा और टूटता गया।

कभी-कभी सोचती हूँ… आखिर क्यों हर बार औरत को ही सहना पड़ता है? जिस इंसान के लिए अपना घर छोड़ा, अपनी पहचान छोड़ी, अपने सपने छोड़े… जब उसी को आपके होने या ना होने से फर्क न पड़े, तब इंसान अंदर से मरने लगता है।

माँ जब तक थीं, हमेशा यही समझाती थीं — “एक दिन सब ठीक हो जाएगा… एक दिन वो तुम्हें समझेंगे।” लेकिन वो दिन कभी नहीं आया। और फिर एक समय ऐसा आया जब मैंने अपने दिल का आखिरी टुकड़ा भी खुद से अलग कर दिया। अब बस बच्चों की जिम्मेदारियाँ पूरी करने के लिए जी रही हूँ।

और आज… वही husband उस शादी का celebration कर रहे हैं… उस रिश्ते का, जिसे उन्होंने शायद कभी सच में समझा ही नहीं… कभी समय ही नहीं दिया।

title: Difficult to handle teenage boys
content:
“Pata nahi mera beta itni jaldi bada kab ho gaya… ab vo har baat mein apni marzi chalana chahta hai. 13 saal ka hote hi usse lagne laga hai ki use sab samajh aa gaya hai. Main kuch bhi samjhau to turant jawab deta hai — ‘Mujhe pata hai’, ‘Main ab chhota nahi hoon.’ Jaise agar main usse mobile thodi der rakhne ko bolu to kehta hai, ‘Sab friends use karte hain, sirf mujhe hi kyu rokte ho?’ Padhai ke liye bolo to bolta hai, ‘Main manage kar lunga.’ Kabhi kapdon ko lekar zidd, kabhi bahar jane ko लेकर argument… aur agar uski baat na mano to mood off karke room mein chala jata hai.

Kabhi kabhi uski zidd aur attitude dekh kar bahut gussa aa jata hai. Fir baad mein khud hi bura lagta hai ki shayad maine zyada daant diya. Dil se to bas itna chahti hoon ki vo sahi raaste par rahe, par samajh nahi aata is teenage age ko kaise handle karun. Kya aap logon ke saath bhi aisa hota hai? Aap apne teenage boys ko kaise samjhate ho?”

title: “Waqt Badal Gaya… Aur Dost Bhi”
content:
School ke din bhi kya din the…
na paison ki tension, na future ka darr…
bas ek hi tension hoti thi —
“Kal school jaake sabse pehle kis se milenge?” ❤️

Riya aur uski 4 dost…
canteen ki ek plate chowmein ko 5 log milkar khate the…
class mein teacher padhate rehte aur peeche inki hasi rukti hi nahi thi.
Ek ki problem sabki problem hoti thi.
Birthday ho ya heartbreak…
sab saath hote the.

Phir school khatam hua…
sabne promise kiya —
“Chahe kuch bhi ho jaye, hum kabhi alag nahi honge.”

Lekin waqt… धीरे धीरे sab badal deta hai.

Koi college ke liye dusre sheher chala gaya…
kisi ki new friend circle ban gayi…
kisi ko career ki tension ne badal diya.

Shuru mein daily calls hote the…
fir weekly…
fir “busy hu yaar, baad mein call karti hu…”
aur ek din pata hi nahi chala kab baatein sirf Instagram stories tak reh gayi.

Riya kabhi kabhi purani chats padhti…
group ki photos dekhkar muskurati bhi thi aur aankhen bhar bhi aati thi.

Aaj bhi uske aas paas log hain…
office friends hain…
kaam ke dost hain…
zarurat padne par help bhi kar dete hain…

Par vo baat nahi hai.

Ab dosti convenience se hoti hai…
tab dil se hua karti thi. 💔

Ab milne se pehle time dekhna padta hai…
tab bina bataye ghar pahunch jate the.

Ab conversations mein formality hoti hai…
tab sirf ek “abe sun…” se dil halka ho jata tha.

Waqt ke saath dost badal nahi jaate shayad…
bas zindagi unhe humse door le jaati hai.

Aur sach to ye hai…
hum sabke paas naye dost to aa jaate hain…
par school aur college wale dost…
dobara kabhi nahi milte… 🥺

title: Growing kids..
content:
Bachpan sach mei dheere dheere hathon se fisalta hai.
Jab bachche chote hote hain to maa sochti hai —
“Bas thode bade ho jayein, thoda waqt khud ke liye mil jaye.”
Aur jab woh sach mei bade hone lagte hain, tab samajh aata hai ki
jo shor kabhi thaka deta tha, wahi ghar ki sabse pyari awaaz thi.

Pehle har choti baat par “mumma” bulate the,
ab kai kaam khud hi kar lete hain.
Pehle har waqt piche piche ghoomte the,
ab unki apni choti si duniya banne lagi hai.
Pyaar aaj bhi utna hi karte hain,
bas jatane ka tareeka badal gaya hai.

Maa ki jagah bhi ajeeb hoti hai.
Woh dost banna bhi chahti hai
aur zarurat padne par rokna bhi.
Kyunki maa ka pyaar sirf laad nahi hota,
usme fikr bhi hoti hai, seekh bhi hoti hai,
aur woh darr bhi ki bachche kahin galat raah na chun lein.

Kai baar bachchon ko maa ki baatein achi nahi lagti,
par maa har baat mei bas unka bhala hi dhundti hai.
Woh hamesha yahi chahti hai ki
bachche acha karein, acha khayein,
aur ek achi zindagi jiyein.

Shayad har maa ek din yahi mehsoos karti hai —
“Meri zarurat khatam nahi hui…
bas pehle jaisi nahi rahi.”

title: Saas ko MA samjho
content:
Nisha ki shaadi ko 5 saal ho chuke the. Ghar mein sab kuch tha… pyaar karne wala pati, do pyare bacche aur ek saas — Sharda Devi.
Lekin Nisha aur unki saas ki kabhi zyada banti nahi thi।

“Bahurani, bartan dhang se rakho…”
“Bacchon ko itna mobile mat do…”
“Subah thoda jaldi uth jaaya karo…”

Har choti baat par saas ki tokataki Nisha ko chubhti thi।
Use lagta tha jaise uski saas use kabhi khush dekhna hi nahi chahti।

Dheere dheere choti choti baatein bade jhagde mein badalne lagi।
Kabhi khane ko lekar, kabhi safai ko lekar… ghar ka mahaul hamesha tanaav bhara rehta।

Ek din baat itni badh gayi ki Sharda Devi chupchaap apna samaan bandh kar boli—
“Lagta hai meri zarurat ab is ghar mein nahi rahi… main bade bete ke paas ja rahi hoon.”

Nisha ne bhi gusse mein kuch nahi kaha।
Andar hi andar use laga…
“Accha hua! Ab na koi rokega, na tokega… ab main apni marzi se jeeyungi।”

Shuru ke kuch din sach mein bahut acche lage।
Der tak sona…
Kitchen mein apne hisaab se kaam karna…
Koi kuch kehne wala nahi।

Lekin dheere dheere sab badalne laga।

Subah bacchon ko school bhejna, unka tiffin banana, ghar saaf karna, bazaar ka kaam, pati ki zaruratein…
Nisha poori tarah thakne lagi।

Kabhi doodh gas par ubal kar gir jaata…
Kabhi bacchon ki bottle dhulna bhool jaati…
Kabhi kapde time par press nahi hote।

Usne mehsoos kiya ki pehle ye sab kaam bina kahe kaise ho jaate the।
Tab use yaad aaya…
Maa ji chupchaap har jagah uski madad kar deti thi।

Bacchon ko khana khila dena…
School bag ready kar dena…
Sabzi kaat dena…
Kabhi uske sir mein dard ho to chai bana dena…

Aur jo tokataki thi…
woh sirf isliye thi taaki Nisha dheere dheere ghar sambhalna seekh jaaye।

Us raat Nisha bahut royi।
Use pehli baar apni galti samajh aayi।

Agli subah woh apne pati ke saath saas ke ghar pahunch gayi।
Darwaza khula… saamne Sharda Devi khadi thi।

Nisha unhe dekhte hi phoot phoot kar ro padi aur gale lag kar boli—
“Ma… mujhe maaf kar dijiye।
Maine aapko bahut galat samjha।
Aap daantti nahi thi… sambhalti thi।”

Sharda Devi ki aankhen bhi bhar aayi।
Unhone pyar se Nisha ke sir par haath rakha aur boli—
“Pagal ladki… maa kabhi apne bacchon ka bura nahi chahti।”

Us din ke baad unke rishte mein sirf saas-bahu ka nahi…
maa-beti wala pyaar aa gaya।

title: Dil Dosti etc..
content:
Hello Friends… How are you all…
Today I want to talk about my friendship connections.

Mere hamesha se bahut zyada friends nahi the.
Jahan bhi gayi, bas ek hi friend bani… aur usi ke saath mera poora waqt nikal gaya.
Group mein rehna mujhe kabhi sahi se aaya hi nahi.

Jab bhi koi mujhse kuch poochta hai, main thodi conscious ho jaati hoon.
Dil mein ek darr sa rehta hai… ki kahin mera jawab saamne wale ko pasand na aaye.
Isi uljhan mein kai baar main khud ko sahi se express hi nahi kar paati.

Mujhe zindagi mein friends hamesha acche mile…
Par mujhe sahi se samajhne wale log kam mile.
Ya shayad… main hi kabhi kisi ko poori tarah samajh nahi paayi.

Kai baar aisa bhi hua ki main logon ke beech hote hue bhi khud ko alag mehsoos karti thi.
Sabke saath hasti thi… baatein bhi karti thi…
Par dil ki baatein har kisi se nahi ho paati thi.

Shayad isi wajah se mujhe gehre connections pasand aaye hamesha…
Jahan dikhawa kam ho aur sukoon zyada mile.

Par baki duniya mere jaise logon ko nahi samajh pati. Har baat par judge karti hai. Shayad isliye mujhe akele rehna jyada pasand hai. Khud ko aise hi accept kar liya hai maine. aur baki logon ka reaction usse bhi ab jyada problem nahi hoti. I decided to live and let them live. 

aap logon ki dosti etc kaisi hai. share if you like.

Thanks

title: suman haar kar bhi jeet gae  (New Beginnings
content:
Suman: Haar Kar Bhi Jeet Gayi


Raat ke 2 baje the…
baarish bahut tez ho rahi thi.
Suman hospital mein baithi thi… aankhon mein aansu aur apne teeno bacchon ko gale lagaye
Doctor bahar aaye aur dheere se bole…
“Hum unhe bacha nahi paaye…”

Us pal Suman ki duniya ruk gayi.
Sirf 28 saal ki umar… aur teen chhote bachchon ki maa.
Ek 7 saal ki beti, ek 5 saal ka beta aur ek nanha sa bachcha.

Pati ke jaane ke baad ghar ke log bhi badalne lage.
Jo log pehle haste hue milte the… ab unki nazron mein sirf bojh tha…
aur kuch log toh usse dekhkar nazrein churaane lage.

Koi kehta,
“Ab kaise palenge itne bachche?”

Koi bolta,
“Dusri shaadi kar lo…”

Aur koi taana maar deta,
“Abhi toh poori zindagi padi hai… akele kaise kategi?”

Yeh sab sun kar Suman har raat toot jaati thi…
par har subah apne bachchon ka chehra dekhkar phir sambhal jaati.

Usne sirf ek baat sochi…
“Mere bachchon ko meri zarurat hai.”

Subah 5 baje uthkar bachchon ko tayaar karti…
unke tiffin banati… school bhejti…
aur phir kaam dhoondne nikal padti.

Suman ek padi-likhi housewife thi.
Uske pati ne kabhi kisi cheez ki kami mehsoos nahi hone di thi.
Par aaj halat bilkul alag the.

Paise itne the ki kuch mahine aaram se nikal sakte the…
par ghar ka kharch, bachchon ki padhai aur unka future…
yeh sab sochkar uski raato ki neend chali gayi thi.

Usne bachchon ko tuition dena shuru kiya.
Din mein 4–5 bachche aate…
phir dheere dheere poori gali ke bachche uske paas padhne aane lage.

Suman ko khana banana bhi bahut pasand tha.
Usne apne isi talent ko apni taqat bana liya…
aur ghar se hi ek chhota sa cloud kitchen shuru kar diya.

Shuru mein sirf 2–3 order aate the…
kabhi poora din intezaar karne ke baad bhi phone nahi bajta tha.
Par Suman ne himmat nahi haari.

Woh raat bhar jagkar naye dishes try karti…
subah jaldi uthkar delivery pack karti…
aur phir bachchon ko school bhejti.

Dheere dheere logon ko uske haath ka swaad pasand aane laga.
Order badhne lage…
Tuition mein bachchon ki sankhya bhi badhne lagi.

Par zindagi ab bhi aasan nahi thi.

Tyohar aate… gharon mein roshni hoti…
par Suman ke ghar mein sirf zimmedariyan hoti.

Woh bachchon ko naye kapde dilwati…
magar hamesha saving dekhkar…
kyunki uske paas choice karne ke zyada options nahi the.

Khud ke liye usne saalon tak kuch naya nahi kharida.
Par bachchon ki har chhoti khushi ka khayal rakha.

Dheere dheere uska kaam badhne laga.
Usne kitchen mein madad ke liye log rakhne shuru kar diye.
Uski din-raat ki mehnat ab rang laane lagi thi.

Saal beet gaye…
Uske haathon ki lakeerein sakht ho gayi…
Chehre ki muskaan kam ho gayi…
Par hausla kabhi kam nahi hua.

Aaj uski beti ek software engineer hai…
aur uski shaadi bhi ek achhe parivaar mein ho chuki hai.

Bada beta ek MNC mein manager ki post par hai…
Aur chhota beta government job ki high post par kaam karta hai.

Ek din teeno bachche uske paas aaye aur bole…
“Maa… aapne humein sirf pala nahi… zindagi jeena sikhaya hai.”

Suman chup thi…
Aankhon mein aansu the…
Par iss baar yeh aansu dard ke nahi… garv ke the.

Kabhi kabhi zindagi sab kuch cheen leti hai…
Par ek maa ka hausla…
woh kabhi nahi tod paati.

title: खुद का हमसफ़र
content:
हर शख़्स से किनारा कर लिया मैंने,
अपने जीने का सहारा ढूँढ लिया मैंने।
खुश हूँ मैं बहुत अब अपने साथ,
खुद को अपना हमसफ़र चुन लिया मैंने।

दुनिया से उलझने की मुझमें समझ नहीं,
दुनिया को समझना छोड़ दिया मैंने।
किसको समझाना, किसे बताना कौन हूँ मैं,
हर किसी को अपनी कहानी सुनाना छोड़ दिया मैंने।

जिसने थोड़ा प्यार दिखाया, उस पर मैंने जहाँ लुटाया,
परायों पर अपना वक़्त लुटाना छोड़ दिया मैंने।

अब जो साथ चले दिल से चले,
ना चले तो मुझसे थोड़ी दूरी से चले,
दूरी से गुज़ारा भी सीख लिया मैंने।

चलना न जिसे गवारा था, दिल से हमारा,
कहीं और जाकर ढूँढो अब तुम अपना सहारा,
क्योंकि तुम्हारे सहारे के बिना जीना सीख लिया मैंने।

title: Importance of Financial Independence
content:
“Husband chahe jitna bhi kama le, wife ke paas apni income hona zaroori hai.”

Aaj bhi bahut log kehte hain, “Tujhe kya zarurat hai kamane ki? Sab kuch to mil hi raha hai.”
Par sawal zarurat ka nahi hai — pehchaan, self-respect aur independence ka hai.

Agar ek ladki padi-likhi hai, qualified hai, to kya sirf isliye poori zindagi ghar baith kar nikaal de ki usse paise ki kami nahi hogi?
Uski mehnat, uski knowledge, uski capabilities — kya sab waste ho jayein?

Apni income sirf paise kamaane ke liye nahi hoti, balki:

khud ke faisle lene ka confidence deti hai
apni pehchaan banaye rakhti hai
aur ek alag hi self-worth ka ehsaas deti hai

Haan, husband ki income se zaruratein poori ho sakti hain, par khulkar jeene ka sukoon tab aata hai jab apne paas apna ho.
Chahe rishta kitna bhi close kyon na ho, har aurat dil se yeh chahti hai ki woh apne kharch apne mann se kare — bina soche, bina jhijhak ke.

Aur sach ye bhi hai —
jaise husband apni kamai se apne liye kuch karna chahta hai, waise hi wife ko bhi woh haq milna chahiye.

Apni income sirf paisa nahi hoti, woh ek confidence hai ki ye maine kisise manga nahi khud kamaya hai. 

baki sabka kya kehna hai is bare mei?

title: Our Health.
content:
Aajkal ke time mein apni mental health ko theek rakhna sach mein bahut mushkil ho gaya hai. Logon ki soch aur unka behaviour itna uljha hua hai ki unse bachne ki koshish karo, phir bhi kabhi na kabhi fas hi jaate hain, aur phir wahi ulajh ke reh jaate hain. Samajh nahi aata ki log dusron ki life mein ghus kar bhi kaise khush reh lete hain, jabki mujhse to apni hi life properly handle nahi hoti.

Yoga, breathing exercises wagairah sunne mein achhe lagte hain, par unka routine banana itna aasaan nahi hota. Har baar sochti hoon start karungi, par samajh hi nahi aata kahan se shuru karun aur kaise continue rakhu. Sabse zyada mushkil ye lagta hai ki ab emotional support bhi kahin nahi milta—har kisi ko sirf apne kaam se matlab hai, kisi ke paas ruk kar sunne ka waqt hi nahi hai.

title: Har chiz se talaak
content:
Maine duniya ki har cheez se talaaq le liya—
is ke banavati pan se, iske dikhave se,
iske matlabi hone se, iske ghamand se,
aur iske jealousy se.

Itni saari kamiyan hain logon mein…
woh sab dekhte bhi hain, samajhte bhi hain,
phir bhi hone dete hain.
Apne karmon ko koi nahi dekhta.
Yeh bhi nahi sochte ki in sab ka anjaam kya hoga.

Kuch log hote hain jo har haal mein
apne karm sahi rakhna chahte hain.
Par duniya unhe pagal, bewakoof kehti hai,
unka mazaak banati hai,
unki feelings ko masal kar
apna kaam nikal leti hai.

Aur phir sawal yeh aata hai—
aur kitna tootna hai is sab mein?
Kab tak yeh ummeed rahegi
ki ek din duniya samjhegi,
hamari keemat pehchaanegi?

Sach yeh hai—
duniya na samajhna chahti hai,
na rukna chahti hai.

Pata nahi kab yeh ummeed chhootegi,
kab main jeena seekh paungi
bina har baat dil par liye.

Kab tak main dusron ki baaton mein
roz thoda-thoda marungi?

Kabhi-kabhi sab bahut mushkil lagta hai.
Kadwahat bahar aaye to karm toot jaate hain,
aur andar rahe to woh hi humein tod deti hai.

Mere karm bhi kabhi-kabhi hil jaate hain…
Main koshish karti hoon apni soch aur apne karm saaf rakhne ki,
par har baar jeet nahi paati.

Sabse alag hone ki koshish karke bhi,
main poori tarah alag nahi ho paati.

title: तेरी किलकारियों में मेरा जहाँ
content:
तेरी प्यारी किलकारियाँ, मेरे दिन की शुरुआत,
तेरा यूँ मुस्कुराना, जैसे समझे मेरे हर जज़्बात।

तुझे देख खिल उठता है मेरा हर एक अरमान,
तेरी हँसी में ही बसता है मेरा सारा जहान।

तुझे गोद में लेकर प्यार से यूँ सहलाना,
फिर तेरे रूठ जाने पर हौले से मनाना।

तेरा यूँ चुप हो जाना, फिर से मुस्कुराना,
हर पल तेरा साथ मुझे जीना सिखाना।

दिन भर तेरा ख़याल, रात को तेरा साथ,
तेरे संग ही सजी है मेरी हर एक बात।

कितना हसीन एहसास तूने दिल को दिया,
चुपचाप ही सही, माँ होने का मतलब सिखा दिया।

title: Ye Kaisa Divorce hai...
content:
Unka divorce kabhi court tak pahucha hi nahi…
na kisi judge ke saamne baat hui,
na kisi kagaz par sign hue.

Phir bhi… rishta khatam ho chuka tha.

Pehle sab normal tha.
Subah ki chai saath,
raat ki baatein lambi…
aur beech beech mein chhoti si hasi,
jo din bana deti thi.

Phir pata hi nahi chala
kab baatein “haan… theek hai” tak simat gayi.

Ab ghar mein awaaz kam,
aur khamoshi zyada rehne lagi thi.

Wo roz uska intezaar karti,
darwaze ki halki si aahat par dil dhadak uthta…
par jab wo andar aata,
to bas bag rakhkar seedha dusre kamre mein chala jata.

“Kaise ho?”
ye sawaal ab bhi hota tha…
par usme pehle wali fikr nahi hoti thi.

Aur jawab?
wo sirf aadat ban gaya tha —
“theek hoon.”

Kabhi kabhi wo chupke se uski taraf dekhti,
sochti —
“kya main ab bhi utni hi zaroori hoon?”

Par ye sawaal uske honton tak kabhi nahi aaya।

Usne apne emotions ko samet liya,
apni baaton ko andar daba liya…
har baar khud ko samjhaya —
“shaayad ye sirf ek phase hai…”

Lekin sach ye tha…
ki wo phase nahi,
ek khatam hota rishta tha।

Na bade jhagde hue,
na kisi ne ghar chhoda…
bas dheere dheere,
dono ek dusre ke dil se nikal gaye।

Ek hi chhat ke neeche rehte hue,
dono ne alag-alag tanhai jee li।

Aur phir ek din…
usne ro kar nahi,
bilkul shaant hokar ye maana —

“Divorce sirf kagaz par nahi hota…
divorce tab hota hai,
jab aap kisi ke saath rehkar bhi
uske bina jeene lagte ho।”

Us din ke baad…
sab waise hi raha — ghar, samaan, routine…
bas rishta nahi raha।

Yahi sabse khamosh,
sabse dardnaak divorce hota hai।

title: Dosti kitni rah gayi...
content:
Priya aur Aisha — teen saal se bestfriends thi.
Ek hi hostel room, ek hi playlist, ek hi dard.
Dono kehti thi — "Tu nahi toh kuch nahi."

College khatam hua. Priya Delhi chali gayi — badi company, bada package.
Aisha wahi rahi — chhote se sheher mein, chhoti si job, bade se sapne.
Shuruaat mein roz baat hoti thi. Phir weekly hue. Phir sirf Instagram stories pe heart aane lage.
Priya busy thi. Nayi city, nayi girls, nayi brunch plans.
Aisha wait karti rahi.

Ek din Aisha ka breakup hua. Wahi banda — jiske baare mein Aisha ne Priya ko sab kuch bataya tha. Har baat. Har raat.
Tooti hui Aisha ne Priya ko call kiya — pehli baar do saal mein.
Teen baar ring hui.
Priya ne uthaya.
"Haan babe, bol! Sab theek?"
Aisha ne rote hue sab kuch bataya. Priya ne suna. Beech mein notification aayi hogi shayad — kyunki Priya boli —
"Aww yaar, tu strong hai. Tu handle kar legi. Main thodi busy hoon abhi, baad mein baat karte hain okay?"
Call cut ho gayi.
Aisha screen ko dekhti rahi.
Aansu rok liye usne. Bahut practice jo thi.
Bas ek kaam kiya — Priya ka contact khola. Naam badla.
"Priya — Sirf Timepass."

Hafte baad Priya ka message aaya —
"Yaar woh red dress yaad hai teri? Kahan se li thi? Meri friend ko chahiye."
Aisha ne message padha. Typing indicator aaya. Phir chali gayi.
Reply nahi kiya.

Woh raat Aisha ne apne purane messages scroll kiye. Teen saal ki baatein. Raaton ko ki hui calls. Ek doosre ke liye roye the kabhi.
Sab tha — par kuch bhi real nahi tha.
Usne diary mein likha —
"Humne ek doosre ko 'bestfriend' bola — par shayad woh sirf ek comfortable habit thi.
Jab habit ki zaroorat nahi rahi — rishta bhi nahi raha.
Maine socha tha yeh dosti thi.
Yeh sirf time tha — jab dono ke paas koi aur nahi tha."

title: Success Takes Time… Not Everyone Understands That
content:
Hello friends,

Today I want to talk about something we all face — success and the time it takes to achieve it.

Why is it that people expect others to succeed quickly?
And if you don’t, they start asking—
"Why aren’t you successful yet?"

But the moment you do achieve something,
the same people often turn silent… or even jealous.

The truth is—growth is a process.
Real success is not built overnight.
It takes patience, consistency, and a lot of unseen effort.

I am not in a hurry.
I believe in taking my own time, learning, growing, and becoming better each day.

But yes… sometimes these constant questions and comparisons can feel irritating.

So I want to ask you all—
How do you deal with such people?
How do you stay focused on your journey without getting affected by outside noise?

Let’s share our thoughts. Maybe we can help each other grow stronger.

title: Log Kya Kahenge… Aur Woh Kya Sehegi?
content:
Riya ne jab divorce papers par sign kiya, us din usne sirf ek rishta nahi chhoda… usne apni saansen wapas le li thi.

Par kahani yahin khatam nahi hui thi.
Asli kahani toh us din shuru hui thi.

Ghar ke bahar kadam rakhte hi nazrein badal gayi thi.
Kuch log chup the… par unki aankhon mein sawal the.
Kuch log bol pade—
“Arre kya hua tha?”
“Thoda adjust kar leti…”
“Shaadi mein thoda upar-niche toh hota hi hai…”
“Ladke toh dusri le aayenge… tera kya hoga? Bacchon ka kya?”

Har sawal ek teer tha… jo baar-baar uske dil ko cheer deta.

Riya bas muskura deti thi.
Kyuki har baar sach batana mumkin nahi hota…
Aur har koi sach samajh bhi nahi sakta.

Raat ko jab sab so jaate…
tab woh toot jaati.
Chup-chaap… bina awaaz ke roti thi.
Itna roti thi ki aansu bhi thak jaate the.

Kabhi-kabhi woh khud se poochti—
“Galat kya tha? Chhodna ya sehna?”
“Alag ho jana galat hai… ya us ghar mein ghut-ghut kar jeena sahi tha?”

Par jawab kabhi seedha nahi hota…

Usne koshish ki thi.
Bohot ki thi.
Har din apne aap ko tod kar… us rishte ko jodne ki koshish ki thi.
Har baar socha tha—
“Bas aaj thoda aur adjust kar leti hoon… kal sab theek ho jayega…”

Par “kal” kabhi nahi aaya.

Aur jab usne finally “bas” kaha…
toh duniya ne use “galat” keh diya.

Sabse zyada dard tab hua…
jab apne hi door ho gaye.
Maa-baap bhi chup ho gaye.
Unki majboori thi… samaj ka darr tha…
par Riya ke liye woh bhi ek tanhaai ban gaya.

Ab har mod par woh akeli thi.
Par pehli baar… woh apne saath thi.

Dheere-dheere usne khud ko sametna shuru kiya.
Chhoti-chhoti khushiyon se dosti ki.
Apni pehchaan wapas dhoondi.
Aur ek din… usne mehsoos kiya—

“Main toot kar khatam nahi hui… main toot kar nayi bani hoon.”

Log aaj bhi poochte hain—
“Sach mein kya hua tha?”

Riya ab muskura kar kehti hai—
“Jo hua… usne mujhe khud se milwa diya.”

Aur shayad…
yeh hi uski jeet thi.

title: New Beginning Started...
content:
Raat ke 2:17 baj rahe the.
Phone screen pe uska naam ab bhi pinned tha…
par chat kholne ki himmat Meera mein ab nahi thi.

“Last seen today at 10:42 PM.”

Divorce ko 3 mahine ho chuke the.
Par aadat… aadat abhi tak gayi nahi thi.

Kabhi bina wajah chat khol leti,
kabhi purane voice notes sun leti…
aur phir khud se hi irritate ho jaati—
“Yaar, move on kar na!”

Sab log bolte the—
“Strong ban, busy reh, forget him…”

Par koi ye nahi batata tha
ki kaise bhoolte hain us insaan ko
jo kabhi tumhari aadat tha, choice nahi।

Ek din usne kuch alag kiya।

Usne chat delete nahi ki।
Block bhi nahi kiya।

Usne bas phone side mein rakha…
aur apni life uthayi।

Subah uthke usne pehli baar bina kisi ko good morning text kiye
khud ke liye chai banayi।
Thodi kadvi thi… par usne pee li।

Phir usne apna purana laptop nikala—
jo shaadi ke baad kabhi use hi nahi hua tha।

Resume khola…
aur kaafi der tak blank screen dekhti rahi।

“Main thi kaun… usse pehle?”

Us din usne job apply ki।
Agle din reject ho gayi।
Phir apply ki।
Phir reject।

Par iss baar… वो टूटी नहीं।

धीरे-धीरे ek routine ban gaya—
subah chai,
dopahar mein kaam ki search,
shaam ko thodi walk…
aur raat ko thoda kam roना।

Ek raat phir 2:17 bajे।

Phone uthaya… reflex se WhatsApp khola…
par is baar aankhon ne uska naam nahi dhunda।

Usne front camera on kiya…
khud ko dekha…

Thodi thaki hui thi,
par pehli baar… akeli nahi lag rahi thi।

Usne dheere se bola—
“Last seen… ab khud ke saath rehna seekh liya hai.”

Aur us raat,
Meera ne kisi aur ko nahi…
khud ko online rakha।

kisiko bhulna aur apni adat badalna itna asan nahi hai. par kuch din ke liye hame jabardasti khudko us raah par jane se rokna hoga. fir dhire dhire hame iski bhi adat ho jayegi us raah par na jane ki. vapas mud kar dekhne par yaad to aayegi dard bhi mehsoos hoga par zindagi isi ka naam hai. 

दर्द समेट कर थोड़ा मुस्कुरा लो,
ज़िंदगी को यूँ कभी मत ठुकराओ।
बिना दर्द के कोई इंसान नहीं,
जिसने खुद को कभी खोया नहीं।
खोकर खुद को फिर ढूंढ लेना—
यही तो है ज़िंदगी का होना ।

title: A Story of a life...
content:
Ek ladki thi jiska naam kuch bhi ho sakta hai, lekin hum use Anamika keh dete hain. Anamika ek seedhi, simple si ladki thi jo zindagi ko bahut gehraai se mehsoos karti thi. Use chhoti chhoti cheezon mein khushi mil jaati thi, aur sabse zyada woh rishton ko importance deti thi.

Uski zindagi bilkul normal chal rahi thi jab uski mulaqat Animesh se hui. Pata nahi kya tha Animesh mein, par Anamika dheere dheere uski taraf khichti chali gayi. Animesh perfect nahi tha — kabhi uska behavior thoda rude hota, kabhi woh ignore kar deta — lekin Anamika ne kabhi in baaton ko seriously nahi liya. Use lagta tha ki pyaar mein sab theek ho jaata hai.

Logon ne use samjhaya bhi. Uske friends ne kaha, “Anamika, tum jaisa soch rahi ho, waise Animesh nahi hai.” Lekin jab dil kisi ko chun leta hai, tab duniya ki koi baat sunai nahi deti. Anamika ne bhi wahi kiya — usne sirf apne dil ki suni.

Kuch time baad dono ne shaadi kar li.

Shaadi ke baad Anamika apni nayi zindagi mein poori tarah se kho gayi. Use lagta tha ki ab usse sab kuch mil gaya hai. Woh subah uthkar ghar sambhalti, Animesh ke liye khana banati, uske ghar walon ka dhyaan rakhti, aur har chhoti badi baat mein khush rehne ki koshish karti. Usne apni puri duniya Animesh ke around bana li thi.

Woh khud ko bahut lucky samajhne lagi thi. Use lagta tha ki uski life perfect hai.

Lekin kabhi kabhi zindagi sab kuch ek hi pal mein badal deti hai.

Ek din Animesh bathroom mein tha aur uska phone baja. Anamika ne bina kuch soche phone utha liya. Dusri taraf se ek ladki ki awaaz aayi, “Hello Animesh!”

Anamika ne normal tone mein kaha, “Woh abhi bathroom mein hain, aap kaun bol rahe hain?” Itna sunte hi phone turant cut ho gaya.

Anamika ko thoda ajeeb laga, lekin usne is baat ko zyada importance nahi diya. Jab Animesh bahar aaya, usne casually usse bataya ki kisi ladki ka phone aaya tha.

Lekin Animesh ka reaction usne expect nahi kiya tha.

Woh achanak gusse mein aa gaya aur tez awaaz mein bola, “Maine tumhe kitni baar kaha hai mera phone mat uthaya karo! Aaj ke baad kabhi bhi mera phone mat uthana.”

Anamika ekdum chup ho gayi. Yeh pehli baar tha jab Animesh ne usse itne gusse mein baat ki thi. Uske dil mein ek ajeeb si chubhan hui. Use samajh nahi aaya ki usne aisa kya galat kar diya.

Us din ke baad Anamika ke andar ek halka sa doubt paida ho gaya.

Usne dheere dheere notice karna shuru kiya ki jaise hi Animesh ka phone bajta, woh turant alert ho jata. Kabhi kabhi woh dusre room mein jaakar baat karta, kabhi balcony mein chala jata. Agar Anamika paas hoti, toh woh ya toh call cut kar deta ya phir bahut dheere awaaz mein baat karta.

Yeh sab dekhkar Anamika ke mann mein sawal badhne lage. Woh confuse thi — kya woh overthink kar rahi hai, ya sach mein kuch galat ho raha hai?

Kuch din tak usne khud ko samjhaya, lekin andar ka doubt khatam nahi hua.

Ek din usne decide kiya ki ab woh sach jaan kar hi rahegi.

Us din jab Animesh ghar se nikla, Anamika bhi chupke se uske peeche nikal gayi. Uska dil bahut tez dhadak raha tha. Woh khud se hi darr rahi thi — agar jo woh soch rahi hai woh sach nikla toh?

Animesh ne apni car ek unknown area mein roki. Woh ek ghar ke saamne gaya. Anamika thodi door khadi sab dekh rahi thi.

Darwaza khula… aur ek ladki saamne aayi.

Us ladki ko dekhte hi Animesh ke chehre par ek alag si muskaan aa gayi — woh muskaan jo Anamika ne kaafi time se nahi dekhi thi.

Dono ne ek dusre ko hug kiya… jaise woh ek dusre ke bahut kareeb ho.

Us moment mein Anamika ko laga jaise kisi ne uska saans rok diya ho. Uski aankhon ke saamne sab dheere dheere dhundhla sa hone laga.

Phir bhi woh wahin khadi rahi.

Kuch der baad dono ghar se bahar aaye, car mein baithe aur seedha office chale gaye — jaise kuch hua hi nahi ho.

Anamika pura din wahi aas paas bhatakti rahi. Uske dimaag mein hazaar sawal the, par jawab ek bhi nahi.

Shaam ko jab Animesh aur woh ladki office se saath nikle, tab bhi Anamika ne unka peecha kiya. Animesh ne use us ladki ke ghar chhoda, aur phir khud apne ghar ke liye nikal gaya.

Anamika uske peeche peeche ghar pahunchi.

Darwaza khula. Animesh normal tha — jaise kuch hua hi nahi ho.

Usne casually poocha, “Kahan gayi thi tum?”

Anamika ne halki si awaaz mein kaha, “Ek friend se milne.”

Us raat Anamika ne koi sawal nahi kiya.

Woh bas chup rahi.

Lekin uski chup ke andar ek tufaan chal raha tha.

Poore raat woh so nahi paayi. Usne apni puri zindagi ke decisions ko yaad kiya. Usne socha ki kaise usne sab kuch chhod kar sirf is ek insaan par bharosa kiya tha.

Agli subah, usne finally himmat jutayi.

Usne seedha Animesh ki aankhon mein dekhkar poocha, “Kaun hai woh ladki?”

Animesh ek pal ke liye ghabra gaya, phir usne aankhon mein aankhein daalne se bachate hue kaha, “Kaun ladki? Tum kya bol rahi ho?”

Anamika ne pehli baar apni awaaz utha kar kaha, “Jhoot mat bolo. Maine sab dekha hai.”

Kuch second ke liye kamre mein bilkul sannata chha gaya.

Phir Animesh ne gusse mein kaha, “Agar dekha hai toh phir pooch kyun rahi ho? Haan, main milta hoon usse. Problem kya hai?”

Yeh sunte hi Anamika ke andar kuch toot gaya.

Lekin jo usne agla suna, usne use bilkul khatam kar diya.

Animesh bola, “Tumse baat karne ka mann nahi karta. Tum boring ho gayi ho. Har waqt bas ghar aur zimmedari. Kisi ko bhi bore ho jayega.”

Anamika chup khadi rahi.

Usne socha tha ki shayad Animesh maafi maangega… shayad explain karega… lekin usne toh saari galti usi par daal di.

Us moment mein Anamika ko samajh aa gaya ki problem usme nahi hai.

Problem yeh hai ki usne galat insaan ko apni puri zindagi de di.

Us din Anamika bahut royi.

Lekin us raat usne ek decision liya.

Usne decide kiya ki woh apni zindagi kisi aise insaan ke saath nahi guzaregi jo uski respect nahi karta.

Divorce ka decision lena aasaan nahi tha.

Ghar wale, society, logon ki baatein — sab kuch uske against tha. Sabne kaha, “Thoda adjust kar lo.” “Shaadi itni aasani se nahi todi jaati.”

Lekin Anamika ne is baar kisi ki nahi suni.

Usne sirf apni suni.

Jab usne divorce papers sign kiye, uske haath kaanp rahe the. Aankhon mein aansu the.

Lekin dil mein pehli baar ek ajeeb si shanti thi.

Kuch mahine baad, Anamika dheere dheere apni zindagi dobara jeene lagi.

Usne khud ko samajhna shuru kiya, apne sapno ko phir se uthaya, aur sabse important — usne khud se pyaar karna seekha.

Aaj bhi usse kabhi kabhi dard mehsoos hota hai. Sochti hai kash woh aisa na hota aur hum puri zindagi pyaar se guzar dete. Lekin aaj woh utni kamzor nahi thi. Aaj woh khudke liye jee rahi thi khudke sath jee rahi thi. Apni zindagi apne hisab se chal rahi thi. Usne apne aapko samjha liya tha ki jo usne kiya hai vahi sahi tha aur adjust mushkilo mei toh woh kar bhi leti par khudko kisi aur ke sath adjust kabhi nahi. 

Kai baar kuch rishte aise ghav ban jate hain jo kabhi nahi bharte. Par zindagi hame jeene ke liye mili hai. Kisi bhi vajah se jab tak hum zinda hai hame jeena nahi chodna chahiye. Aur khudko khush rakhna chahiye.

title: Mrs. Perfect Bahu… in Training 😄
content:
When Riya got married, she entered her in-laws’ house with dreams, excitement… and a suitcase full of YouTube “Perfect Bahu” tutorials in her mind.

“Subah 5 baje uthna hai.”
“Sabko chai deni hai.”
“Har waqt smile 😊”

Day 1:
She woke up at 5 AM… feeling like a warrior.
Went to the kitchen confidently… only to realize—
Gas ka lighter kahan hai? 🤦‍♀️

After 10 minutes of struggle, she finally made tea.
But when everyone tasted it…

Saas: “Beta, chai mein chini daali hai ya namak?”
Riya (internally): Aaj hi ghar wapas chale jaaye kya… 😭

Day 3:
Riya decided to impress everyone with aloo paratha.

Result?
Aloo alag… paratha alag…
It looked like a “before and after” cooking show 😅

Her husband laughed,
“Tumne MasterChef ka audition diya tha ya comedy show ka?”

She glared at him…
but then both burst out laughing.

Day 7:
Riya realized something important—
Trying to be “perfect” was making her tired… and honestly, a little silly too.

So, she changed her strategy.

Instead of pretending, she started asking.

“Saasu maa, chai ka perfect taste kaise aata hai?”
“Yeh sabzi mein tadka kab dalte hain?”

At first, her mother-in-law was surprised.
Then slowly… she started smiling.

One day, while teaching her, she said,
“Perfect bahu banne ki zarurat nahi hai… bas apni jagah bana lo.”

That line hit Riya’s heart.

Weeks passed…

Riya still burnt a few rotis (okay, many 😄)
Still mixed up spices sometimes…
But now, the kitchen had laughter instead of fear.

Her husband started helping her secretly (especially in “damage control”).
Her father-in-law became her “taste tester.”
And her saas?
She became her biggest teacher… and slowly, a friend.

One evening, while serving dinner, her saas said,
“Aaj ki dal bahut acchi bani hai.”

Riya smiled proudly and whispered,
“Thank you YouTube… and Saasu maa 😄”
